notes.title: Dysterra Full Release – Play for Free!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience.
Dysterra has finally completed its long period of refinement and is now transitioning to its official release.
Here are the key changes of the full release of Dysterra.

Update schedule

 Europe: Apr 17th, 2025, 2:00 AM to 7:00 AM (CET)
 America: Apr 16th, 2025, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM (PST)
 Asia: Apr 17th, 2025, 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM (KST)


Dysterra Goes Free-to-Play! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2c6cd35e5ddca724f474128b79c368207ebcbaae.jpg
Dysterra is going free-to-play very soon! We understand that you may have many questions about this change, so we’d like to take this opportunity to explain the details.
With the transition to free-to-play, we are also introducing the Founder’s Pack DLC.
 All players who have previously purchased Dysterra will receive this DLC for free.
The Founder’s Pack DLC includes the following benefits:

3,000TP for Terra Shop (only for new purchaser)
Access to official servers
Ability to claim daily/weekly rewards
Listed on the global rankings
Content unlocks in specific areas of single-player mode

Players who are using the free version will need to purchase the Founder’s Pack DLC to access these features.

If you're new to the game, we recommend getting familiar with the mechanics through single-player mode or custom servers. Once you're ready to earn TP (Terrasite Points), you can join the official servers.
Existing players can either play on custom servers to enjoy the game with free players or join the official servers to compete and earn TP.
We deeply appreciate those who supported Dysterra early on by purchasing and playing the game.🚀

Time-Limited Skins Introduced 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/27fa5cee6b3a1acbe5b4446646f2acd63831208c.png
All currently available skins, as well as future skins, will now be time-limited.
However, any skins you have already purchased will remain permanent and will not be affected by this change.
To celebrate the official launch, we are introducing the "Orbis Container - Skull Silver Skins"! 🎉


Ranking System Change
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b9c84a56b1efa18ce066140b403242cffeade205.png
PvP and PvE rankings will now be separated.
Weekly rewards will also be divided into two categories, ensuring that players can compete more fairly based on their preferred playstyle.
All previous rankings before this update will be reset.

Environmental Changes 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/08d8421e3e342cb7154df09bcbac92e17dc39505.png
Longer Nights 🌙
 The nights on Ararat Island will now last longer.

Rain Returns ☔
 After a long dry spell, rain will finally make a comeback.

More Dynamic Temperature Changes 🌡️
 Each region’s temperature will now fluctuate more noticeably depending on the time of day.

At night, it will get colder.
Rain will make temperatures drop even further.
In open areas like the Gamma Zone, where there are no trees to block sunlight, daytime will feel hotter.

Survival Adjustments
 Players can counter harsh weather conditions by equipping armor, using pills, or injections.

Armor’s environmental resistance has been significantly increased, making it a more effective way to withstand extreme temperatures.

Weapon & Armor Changes 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/047ffeee08cbb22197cf4f74065ff3254e3e1756.png
The crafting bench has always been a reliable companion, producing equipment with consistent performance. However, this will now change.
From now on, weapons, melee weapons, and armor crafted at the bench will have varying stats each time they are made.

Weapon Grades Introduced
        Survivors can check a weapon's performance based on its grade.
Weapon Stat Changes in the Journal 
        You can track how weapons evolve by checking your Journal.

Additionally, the durability enhancement system has been revamped to strengthen overall stats, not just durability.

Higher-Grade Gear = Better Enhancements
         Strengthening high-quality equipment will provide greater stat boosts compared to upgrading 
         standard gear. So, if possible, focus on enhancing higher-grade equipment for the best results! 
        🔧💥


Gun Recoil Adjustments 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/51b5a3091803efb9efeda36fb8e36ee1b4f08d8a.png
Assault rifles and submachine guns have been the dominant weapon choices in the game. To encourage more diverse weapon usage, we have completely redesigned gun recoil mechanics.

Sniper rifles & designated marksman rifles (DMRs)📈
        Significantly reduced recoil, making them easier to handle and more viable in combat.
Submachine guns (SMGs)📉
        Increased recoil, making it harder to hit distant targets.

These changes aim to create a more balanced and varied gunplay experience! 🎯

New Lighting Feature Added 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1f795c5b3388679ae44d746fe00527fc2268b210.png
With longer and darker nights, we’ve added a new Searchlight to help players illuminate their surroundings more effectively.

You can manually aim the light where you want it to shine.
By holding the interaction key, you can adjust the direction of the beam, allowing for near full-range coverage in any direction.

Perfect for base defense, night raids, or simply lighting up the dark wilderness! 💡🌌


Terrafire Cycle Adjustments 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/683de753bc1af14aa1d502d50d3af44849af6e75.png
With the enhancement of weapons and armor, the Terrafire cycle will now be extended.

PvE Server Changes 🌍
   Initial Duration: 4 months (120 days)
   Minimum Duration: 3 months (90 days)
   Maximum Duration: 6 months (180 days)
PvP Servers 🔥
   No changes – the existing cycle will remain the same.

Some of you may have noticed strange behavior from monsters, including bears, in recent times. Thanks to the relentless efforts of Orbis scientists, the cause has finally been identified. notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.6.19
notes.notes:
It's been a while since we've greeted you all, and the development team would like to share some updates on the current development direction of Dysterra, along with a small balance patch.

We are planning to reintroduce some of the survival elements that were intentionally reduced in gameplay. We believe that certain systems, which were removed due to causing inconvenience in areas like difficulty, PvP, and NPC battles, should be revived. Specifically, we are reorganizing the temperature system. We are testing several systems, including bringing back the weather system from the previous open beta test and introducing temperature variations.
Regarding this week's balance patch, we have made several stat improvements to the gliding skill, which has been rarely used, to make it more enjoyable and useful. Additionally, we felt that some adjustments were necessary for the grenades, which were enhanced in the last patch. Therefore, we have made some downward adjustments to a few values, ensuring we do not undermine the original intent of the design.
Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.6.8
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors!

Brace yourself for intensified Home Invasions that pose a threat to your base, featuring dynamic difficulty levels based on your skill and shelter complexity. Plus, bid farewell to the festive season as we say goodbye to Christmas decorations. Now, let's dive into the details!



Protect Your PvE Base, too!
Recently, we included the ‘Home Invasion’ event to all of our servers where Hyena or Orbis troops will appear near your base and launch an attack.

Be sure to safeguard your hard-earned progress and valuable items by fortifying your base with internal and external defenses. That may be traps, turrets, or something else. The choice is yours.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c0217b2ba3885ba001c8e4795852c43e38a3524d.png


Changes to Home Invasion Conditions
Home Invasions come in five varieties, each with an escalating difficulty level. We’re introducing shelter complexity to the algorithm to ensure a more dynamic invasion level selection based on your skill as well as the size of your base. Shelter complexity is a measure of several factors including: the number of items installed in your base (including walls and foundations), and the level of said items. You can easily check your 'Shelter Complexity' in your building core's menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e26d2445c3b98f519a3c0c2a0fda7bb0c8404e3d.png


Farewell, Christmas Decorations!
As we bid adieu to the holiday season, all in-game holiday-themed items and skins will be officially removed. Your placed holiday items will retain their festive skins until picked up or uninstalled.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7045ecc4028a81b624ed188fd97bc9ec221ea77a.png


Bug Fixes & Optimizations
🦋 Optimized memory use for custom servers.
🐛 Fixed a bug where mobs were unable to cause damage to player bases.
🐛 Fixed an issue where lights would remain in place even after their corresponding wall was destroyed.

2x gathering boost:
Excluding special items like keys, all gathering will be doubled over the weekend. This includes terrasite, stone, and metal, as well as all containers and NPCs around Ararat Island.

We’re always listening to player feedback, and this week is no different. This week we’ve got improvements to base-building, an upgrade to our anti-cheat measures, and improvements to base efficiency and rocket launcher recoil.



Stack Pillars
You asked for it, and now it’s here! You can now stack pillars on top of one another without any floors between them. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e3b52f75139ac936d6a69edd6f672feeab3274f7.png


Better Anti-Cheat
Providing a fair gaming experience to players is one of our top priorities. To achieve this, we are switching our anti-cheat tool to "Easy Anti-Cheat." Easy Anti-Cheat is currently used by several renowned games and is recognized as an excellent anti-cheat solution. To learn more, please refer to their website.



Better Miner Efficiency
We’ve reduced the energy usage of mining machines to give players more leeway when it comes to endgame energy expenditures.

Before: 400 energy/min.
After: 250 energy/min.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9f794ab3956b76f1821258fd245626282efc0017.png


Reduced Rocket Recoil
We want it to be easier for survivors to adjust their aim after firing a rocket.

🐛 Fixed a bug where the corpse of Hyena Axemen and Shotgunners were not detected by vision scan.
🐛 Resolved an issue in the character customization window where players using a gamepad weren’t able to select a hair color.
🐛 Fixed an abnormal behavior of explosive weapons' area damage.
🐛 When destroying existing housing parts, survivors used to receive nothing back if only 1 of a material was used in its crafting. Players will now receive 1 of said material back when destroying that housing part. (e.g. 1/4 Foundation Lv.4).
🐛 Fixed a bug where garage doors were able to overlap.
🐛 Adjusted the crafting bench price for vehicle battery cells, so that crafting with or without a crafting bench will use the same recipe. (Only 2 lithium is required no matter where you craft)

Repeater Area Color Change
We changed the color of the repeater’s available area to help it be more easily distinguished from the building core’s area sphere.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/78faa2f97a36966c49c45344dddf14c7d9102097.png


Siege Jammer Change
When a siege jammer is activating, it is now possible to install mines (excluding bounding mines).



Base Part Changes
We’ve made some improvements to how the a couple of base parts operate:

Recycler
👊 If the recycler runs out of power mid-operation, it will resume operation once power is restored.

Barrel Grill
👊 You cannot begin cooking an item while the barrel grill’s inventory is full.

Bounding Mines, Holograms, Electric Floors
👊 They now require an active, powered building core to be turned on.



Cyclops Attack Improvement
When a cyclops performs a teleportation attack, it will now check whether the destination location is valid before it performs the attack.



Bugs & Optimizations

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.5.11
notes.notes:
How’s everyone doing today?? What better way to enjoy the crisp Autumn air than to snuggle close to your computer while playing Dysterra. We have some more updates this week to make your life easier, starting with an improvement to grenade throwing. We look forward to seeing you all on the servers!



Better Grenade Accuracy!
Throw grenades exactly where you want them to land. Grenades now lose most of their velocity when hitting a wall or landing on the ground.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9065df04ace5978016d40eaf7014850a8e4fce55.png



Get In the Action Faster
For all of you busy players out there, we’ve upgraded the equipment you start with on the Global Uncapped PvP & Global PvP Hardcore servers.

New players will start with the following equipment:
Fine Reinf. Fiber Armor Set
= Helmet, upper suit, & lower suit (non-repairable)
SMG MMP-500X ECLAIR (non-repairable)
Light Ammo: x2000
Dash Protocol
Healing Protocol
Canned Meat Stew



Level Up
Getting your first skill level just got faster! We’ve reduced the xp points required to get to level one for new players to start strategizing their play that much sooner.

Pts required to reach level 1
Before: 1000
Now: 100

(Note: The amount of points from level 1 to level 2 remains the same.)



Six More New Perks
We’ve added 6 new perks to the game:
🎲 Weaponsmith - Blades
🎲 Weaponsmith - Blunts
🎲 Weaponsmith - Short Range Guns
🎲 Weaponsmith - Mid Range Guns
🎲 Weaponsmith - Long Range Guns
🎲 Weaponsmith - Rocket Launchers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7093670bc184b73df7246fcaba528f5ecb92825e.png

Each of these will add an additional possible level for their corresponding skill, allowing up to 30% or 40% higher max durability when crafting the related weapon type. You’ll now be even more prepared to take on new areas and new enemies knowing you’ll be stronger than ever before with your handy perk!

To encourage their distribution, we’ll be doubling the drop rates of these 6 perks for the next 2 weeks until Wednesday, November 1st.



Base Repair Improvement
If you have a level 2 building core or higher, you’re able to remotely repair parts of your base. We’ve added a notification that will pop up when you’re unable to repair something. It’ll tell you why you can’t: insufficient resources, base part is in cooldown, etc. No more wondering why something isn’t letting you repair it!



Mob AI
Mobs will now continue to chase you even after you hide around corners or somewhere out of sight.



Bug Fixes & Optimizations
🦋 Frame drop issue when entering build mode with a large number of build parts in the world.
🦋 Optimization for low-end devices experiencing low frames in the lobby. 
🐛 Pistol firing delay wasn’t correctly being applied when while running. 
🐛 Issue where the firing animation is displayed when switching to automatic mode after a single shot in single-shot mode.
🐛 Issue where the timer on the incubator is displayed even when it drops below 0 seconds.
🐛 Incubator issue where the remaining time resets to the moment of reactivation every time the fuel slot is refreshed after stopping and then restarting the operating incubator.
🐛 Level 2 incubator localization issue.
🐛 Issue with item quantity getting cut off by commas when using the UI's Tooltip for Item Split. 
🐛 Durability not functioning correctly when using the Item Split feature with stacks.
🐛 Fixed the issue of XeSS not being applied after restarting the game when activated from the graphics options.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.5.6
notes.notes:
We have another patch for you all! This one includes some more small improvements to polish gameplay as well as a small set of bug fixes. We hope you enjoy the changes!

Added Nitrado Link in-game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f3ce4fa7a8c334f1c9c183f07e7496ad3f7ba576.png
We’ve added two buttons to the lobby’s menus. One is a link to Nitrado.com for less technical players who would like to add a custom server without the hassles that come with hosting your own custom server.

We’ve also added a link to our guide on making a custom server for players to easily access the list of server commands and other necessary information.



Turrets vs. NPCs = No loot drop
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7f592e17154ad1a122a670f685397933dbd79f16.png
When a mob dies and more than 50% of damage was caused by a turret, loot will not drop.



Beware the Axemen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/be1d694438b70044d37ce4cdcc76c08d9fb6a178.png
Hyena Axemen can now throw their axes at you.



Clans: See what you missed
You’ll now be able to scroll to see what your clan was talking about while you were away.



Who Will Lead Us?
You can now rest easy knowing that the clan masters may now bequeath their admin rights to a member that they deem worthy.



Bug Fixes
◀ Fixed bug where Stryder EX only displayed 5 of its 20 inventory slots.
◀ Fixed an issue where the building grid displayed as red if the player died while installing something.
◀ Fixed an issue where turrets would aim at something where there was nothing to aim at.
◀ Fixed issue where other player’s build parts would display in the Integrated Utility Controller.
◀ Fixed issue where manipulating one’s building core through the integrated utility controller resulted in the UI displaying incorrectly.
◀ Removing a 1st story wall will retain the walls above if the surrounding stability factor is stable enough.
◀ Corrected issue where a wall was see-through during animations.
◀ Added an Epic-tier terrasite capsule where one was missing in the Chemochamber.
◀ Changing the world settings to increase resource drops should now take effect immediately.
◀ Single Player: The controllers for the Geolab and Chemochamber should now work properly.
◀ Custom Server: Fixed crash that would occur when setting ‘ConfigurableValues MaxTeamSize’ to ‘0’
◀ Custom Server: Setting the building core invite value to 0 now disables the permanent sharing of core-rights.
◀ Mobs will no longer be able to detect players who are both in their car or behind a wall.
◀ Mobs will no longer jitter when they can’t find a path to the player.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.5.5
notes.notes:
We’re adding more quality of life improvements in this week’s patch.
This week’s patch is focused on player UI. We’re trying to fix a number of common friction points, as well as adding information where it wasn’t being displayed. If you have any ideas for further UI optimization or improvements, please add your ideas to the Season 4 feedback channel on our Discord server!

Vehicle QOL Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/37c99f4027234f22101706e5a26f427e0f2d69f9.png
🚗 Headlights and backlights will now turn on or off as soon as you press the forward / backward key, not when your vehicle changes direction.
🚗 Passengers will now also see headlights and backlights turning on or off just as the driver sees them.
🚗 Pressing the brake key will now deactivate the vehicle’s acceleration, effectively putting it in neutral.


Craft Bandages at Consumable Bench
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/df30fbc3da49f3ed963914388352f71345343fb9.png
Lv.1 Bandages can now be produced at the Consumable’s Bench at a cost of 2 fiber.


Repair Bench UI Change
Changed the Repair Bench’s UI to reflect durability skill buffs.
Player durability buffs weren’t displayed in the repair bench, but now you can be sure of exactly how strong your guns are, and how long they’ll last when you’re repairing them.


Perk Name Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2a007f360e8b5ac386cb7b3bb9904475c5f8a712.png
We renamed the reload speed perks for players to more intuitively understand what it does, and which guns are affected.

Previous Names
Speed Loader - Pistols
Tactical Reload - Assault Rifles
Tactical reload - Sniper Rifles 
Tactical Reload - Rocket Launchers

Current Names
Speed Loader - Short Range Guns
Speed Loader - Mid Range Guns
Speed Loader - Long Range Guns 
Speed Loader - Rocket Launchers


General Stability Optimization
We optimized the code around how base parts communicate stability data to each other.

Fixes & Optimizations
🔹 We changed the name of the “Reactor Engine Box” to the “Maintenance Bay Reactor” to better reflect its location.
🔹 We also added information the the maintenance bay reactor’s description that will give new players a hint about how to get the reactor.

notes.notes:
We’re getting really close to revealing what we’ve been working on for our next big update. I’ll be sharing a little about what we’re preparing later this week in a separate game note. For this week’s patch, we have a couple balance changes and bug fixes. If dummy decoys or bounding mines are in your armory, keep on reading.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b28543d0759b0f7b72e94b049ce6654280252c84.png
Some Orbis and Hyena mobs only shot their guns while standing still. We’ve put them through training, and they’re now able to shoot while running, especially while dodging the player’s aim.



Dummy Decoy Duration Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d8e913e1e2007ea710565838387649fff6c9abc7.png
Small adjustments were made with the goal of ensuring better balance across a variety of situations. The active duration of Dummy Decoys has been slightly reduced to help them be more tactical, and to reduce clutter when several are used.


New Dummy Decoy Active Duration
🚀 Lv.1: 2 minutes (120 sec)
🚀 Lv.2: 5 minutes (300 sec)



Bounding Mines Not Affected By EMP
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6da1951c87e1f8d283bfc7ebccf4d91371ccb736.png
Defending your base and your possessions is priority #1 on Ararat island. The last thing anyone wants is to log in and find that someone has touched their stuff. You can rest a little more easily knowing that bounding mines will no longer be affected by EMPs. They’ll stay powered at all times, ensuring that any intruder to your base will have to think twice before approaching your front door.

notes.notes:
It’s patch time again! We’ve got some new, top-tier weapon attachments, some quality of life fixes to mob looting, the transmitter store, and fixed a couple of bugs. We’ll be making a major announcement in the next week or two, so keep your eyes peeled!



4 New Attachments!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/bb01607a48a9b3a94e75cae7e9933023dd6088ba.png
We’ve added 4 new, yellow-tier attachments: a silencer, a compensator, a vertical grip, and an extended magazine. These will be found in facilities where you used to find the purple tier attachments. Except for the extended magazine, they are not craftable. You’ll have to find them at facilities.

 Bullet Speed: -4%
 Recoil Control: +4%

Compensator CS-05

 Bullet Speed: -4%
 Recoil Control: +14%

Vertical Grip VTG-05

 Recoil Control: +14%

Extended Magazine HM-02

 Reloading Speed -6%




ADS Fix
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/50c43f91d6cc1dc4cbfef9529f24a9ddb2de4fbc.png
We fixed some sight issues when zooming in with gun sights (aim down sights) on the following guns:
[olist]
SMG MMP-500X ECLAIR
Energy DMR
ENERGY ASSAULT RIFLE EC MK-III 
[/olist]



Transmitter Duplicates Be Gone!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/27b443cb90c5c8875927aaa069d76a5263fbe3c2.png
Each day, the transmitter displays the items of the day, but it would show 2 or 3 of the same item on rare occasions.

We rewrote the transmitter’s code to make sure that each item in the daily item list is different.



Loot Stealing in PVE Mode? Never again!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f4af14f752c922f3da56c3134784ea8f6c572682.png
To prevent loot stealing, especially with facility bosses, we’ve added a new feature to PvE servers where only the player that inflicted the most damage on an enemy can take that enemy’s loot.

This does not apply to people on your team, so anyone on the team of the person who inflicted the most damage will also have the right to loot the mob in question.




Added casting time for pills
Until now, there has been no casting time when using a number of medical items, specifically pills.

When using pills during combat, the absence of a casting time did not align with our intended balance for the game. Therefore, we have added a short casting time and animations when using medications, similar to with bandages and syringes.

🔹 Fixed issue where Ground Stabilization applied excessive repair amount to building parts.

🔹 Fixed issue where crafting stations couldn't recognize crafting materials during the crafting process.

🔹 Fixed issue where a player’s inventory slot count was not increased after acquiring the Big Bag skill.

🔹 Fixed issue where the crafting station UI showed insufficient energy after destroying one’s core and installing a new one.

🔹 Fixed issue where general items in the transmitter were not displayed correctly.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.5
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to bring you the latest update for DYSTERRA, packed with exciting new features, improvements, and bug fixes. This update introduces an enhanced Perk System, empowering players to level up their perks for additional effects and faster progression. The Hologram Decoy receives an update, allowing turrets and mobs to recognize it as a threat. We've also expanded the Titanium acquisition path, making it easier to obtain both fine and regular Titanium. Additionally, we've made various improvements and addressed several bugs to enhance your gameplay experience. Read on for more details!

Here's a breakdown of what to expect:

Enhanced Perk System:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b494565037c4356649b661b3c674a21f55a21fc8.png
Introducing the new Perk Upgrade feature.
Players can now level up their perks by using three cards of the same level and TP to ascend their gameplay to the next level.
Leveling up grants random additional effects, aiding your progression in the game.



Hologram Decoy Update:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d8e913e1e2007ea710565838387649fff6c9abc7.png
Turrets and NPCs now recognize decoys as hostile entities and will attempt to attack them. Since attacking a ‘hologram’ shouldn’t be possible, we’re changing its name to ‘Dummy Decoy’. Use dummy decoys strategically in housing areas or in areas with high mob density to divert their attention and gain a tactical advantage.



Expanded Titanium Acquisition Path:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d159259f4d0afd680af39152d40c62fc1c8a5464.png
Obtaining fine and regular titanium has become more accessible. Defeat Juggernauts to obtain fine titanium, and acquire regular titanium through advanced supply pods.



Weapons Balancing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5ac817cf5b85aa2fee86088c4023c4beed93b51a.png
After carefully evaluating player feedback and analyzing gameplay data, we have identified an opportunity to further enhance the balance of our game. As part of our ongoing efforts to ensure an optimal gaming experience, we have made adjustments to the siege hammers and their impact on housing walls. These changes aim to fine-tune the gameplay mechanics and provide a more balanced and enjoyable experience for all players.


Please take note of the following changes:
Siege Hammer IGX-1:
Attack Power: 90 pts
Housing Multiplier: 100% ➡️ 78%
Housing Attack Power: 90 pts ➡️ 70 pts

Siege Hammer IGXX-100:
Attack Power: 110 pts
Housing Multiplier: 200% ➡️ 132%
Housing Attack Power: 220 pts ➡️ 145 pts



Additional Improvements:

🔹 In Single Player mode, pressing the system menu (ESC) now pauses the world.

🔹 In the lobby, clicking ‘continue’ in the single player menu will open the world settings options.

🔹 Increased the maximum HP of the Integrated Utility Controller from 1,000 to 5,000. (The increase in max HP does not mean a reduction in the existing HP.) Any Integrated Utility Controllers that are currently installed can be reinforced through repairs to match the increased maximum HP.

🔹Notification added when attempting to gather items while inventory is full.

🔹 Reduced Satellite Station cooldown time, as well as the expiration time of the Satellite Station Chip from 5 hours to 2 hours.

🔹 Enhanced mantling mechanics, expanding the allowable range and increasing speed.

🔹 Improved animation responsiveness when acquiring resources while holding a firearm.

🔹 Adjusted firearm sound effects to match magazine consumption. (i.e. 5 bullets = 5 shots heard)



Bug Fixes:

🔹 Fixed an issue where vehicles could pass through the surfaces when at high speeds.

🔹 Resolved an issue where ¼ foundations could be built on top of base foundations.

🔹 Fixed instances where turrets connected to certain building cores would mistakenly target friendly entities (= players registered to the building core).

🔹 Addressed an issue where post-teleportation invincibility time was canceled upon entering the escape rocket immediately after teleportation.

🔹 Resolved an issue where trees would regenerate on top of foundations.

Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. We hope you enjoy this update and wish you the best of luck in your survival journey!

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.4
notes.notes:
Our development team in Korea is hard working on optimizing the game for future updates, so this week’s patch is a bit small. We’re patching the map to eliminate unfair bases, as well as making some small changes to the mob loot drop table.

Unfair Base Locations Gone!
Players were building their bases in unfair locations, often using bugs to build in locations where it was completely impossible to attack their base.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/676c616433f67deb9c84cc2c24c5dbccc3d00cbe.png

We’ve blocked off areas that we deemed overly unfair to make sure that everyone has a chance at being looted. We may have missed some spots, though, so let us know if you find a base that is 100% impossible to attack, and we’ll patch that spot up.

We still want the map to have easily defendable locations, and hidden locations. The goal of this update is simply to eliminate spots around the map that were impossible to loot.


Changes to Mob Drops
Please note that some mob drops have changed. Low-level Hyena troops can now drop both Silicon Fiber and Microparts. Stompers will now drop Fine Silicon Fiber.

Fixes and Improvements

The LOOT-a-LOT is over. 😢
It was so exciting to see everyone working together for a common purpose, and we had a hoot watching you try to shoot and loot our base. 

A good portion of our team is taking a much-needed break after playing Dysterra with you all over the weekend, so this week’s patch is mostly just event rewards and basic bug fixes, with a notable change to turrets.

LOOT-a-LOT Event Rewards!

Thanks to everyone who joined the LOOT-a-LOT event!! We had a great time fighting against you all, and were happy to see so many players that were CLEARLY very skilled at raiding bases.

In this week’s patch, you’ll be receiving your rewards for the event. Please remember that you had to be logged in to the event server at the moment the Devs’ building core was destroyed in order to receive ‘1’ loot point (for a maximum of 3 points). Players with 3 points or more will receive the sum of all listed rewards. If there is a problem with your rewards, please email us your steam ID number and a description of your issue at community_dysterra@realitymagiq.com.

As promised, the rewards are as follows:
Scroll down to learn more about the new armor recipe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/dabb4eb43f8a353954b74daa3fe574dbb23cd8b2.png




New Armor
This isn’t your grandma’s Fine Metal Suit! The ‘Fine Metal Suit [Golden]’ is not a skin, it’s a better version of the Fine Metal Suit, with its own better stats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c0acaf7bc206f9633fcc3b1a4f2426878637ebfb.png
We’re giving the recipe out to players who succeeded at least twice in last weekend’s Loot-a-lot event.


Helmet + Upper Suit + Lower Suit
Tier: Rare
Durability: 1,050 for each piece

Resistance (Combined Full-set)
Physical:  8%
Energy:   86%
Bleeding: 19%
Fracture:	25%
Radiation: 0%



Rewards change if you ride the rocket

This one is just a reminder:
As I stated when we introduced Perks, you’ll get different levels of Perk Pack depending on your ranking when your server expires. If you get on the rocket at the end, your level of Perk Pack goes up 1 tier. The Perk feature has a maximum level of Lv. 3, and the higher-tier Perk Packs vary by changing the probability of obtaining higher-level perks.

Jump on over to our still-under-construction wiki to read all about perks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/51004157104f3061aa2a3f71fbe32cc9e82e593d.png

We’ve also made changes to the ‘scoreboard’ at the end of a server’s lifespan to show you which reward you’re getting.


Holograms Are Easier To Destroy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d8e913e1e2007ea710565838387649fff6c9abc7.png

We wanted holograms to be more useful. The hologram base’s hit box was too small, so we changed where you can now shoot the decoy image to destroy it. We hope you all make good use of this new feature.

Note: Since shooting a hologram isn’t possible, we’re also changing the name to Dummy Decoy. 




Other Fixes and Improvements
🔹 Fixed an issue with dragging and dropping gun components.
🔹 The Painstaker gun should now always be able to damage Orbis turrets.
🔹 Fixed an issue with placing ¼ and triangle foundations.
🔹 Set a max FPS for the game lobby.
🔹 Akashic Data Cards now net you 1000 points when you send them through the transmitter.
🔹 New items have been added to the Transmitter's product list. (Fine Silicon Fiber, Fine Bolts, Fine Microparts)

Did you install several turrets only for them to be rendered useless with an EMP? Are you tired of them needing to be manually turned back on after an EMP? Well worry no more! This update is here to help. We’ve made several changes to help offline raids be less of a headache to those of you that have invested precious hours of your time into designing and creating your bases.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c2a911ea791d90dabb198c01e5fcae7bcb39da9b.png

We hope you’re all enjoying the plethora of new content we added to the game last week. This week has even more in store, including more in the store! We’ve added 3 new sets of armor, the ability to reset your character, and fixed a number of bugs.

Update Maintenance Time:
Thursday, May 18th
(PST) 00:00-02:00
(CET) 09:00-11:00

Reset Your Character!
Are you unhappy with your character’s skills? Do you wish you could equip new or different perks? Well now you can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/147b62a6848f58e004bbfbf20b790a051c85558c.png
We’ve added a new feature that allows survivors to redesign your character, reset any equipped perk cards, and even reset your characters skill points for you to redistribute them. Don’t worry, the first reset is free for each server, but subsequent resets will consume more and more TP(terrapoints/lobby currency) each time you reset your character on a given server. The cost will reset to zero after each Terrafire, so feel free to experiment and try different perks and skill stragtegies!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/789d2bdbdc0d06546011abac74bf74816c44534c.png



New Legendary Armor: Titanica

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d6e7501a2b32316ad18d0a60d000efc80bfab94e.png
We’ve introduced 3 new sets of armor. These sets have strong energy resistance and excellent durability but are susceptible to explosion damage. One set will be craftable by default, another set’s recipe will need to be unlocked through the lobby store, and the third can only be acquired by purchasing it at a terrasite transmitter.

We’re experimenting with implementing new ways to acquire armor types and skins, so let us know what you think on our Discord server!



Terra Shop Update
We simplified the lobby’s Terra Shop interface by combining similar items into respective recipe boxes! We’ve also removed the Orbis Containers, and replaced them with recipe boxes that are sorted by skin-style, but include a variety of other skin recipes. If you like argyle patterns, you can buy an argyle skin recipe, and if you like skull patterns, you can try purchasing a skull skin box.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9941ddfd4fd25840c86851b461988abb45c39209.png
This will help people purchase what they want without being overwhelmed by a super-long list of items. That’s why we’ve also organized all of the housing decor into a single random box for users to purchase.



Improvements and Bug Fixes:

🔹 TerraShop: Removal of random boxes and addition of new random boxes.
🔹 Orbis Boxes: Removal of Orbis Boxes and addition of skin-themed boxes.
🔹 Discontinuation of individual sale of facility recipes and addition of facility boxes.
🔹 Fixed animation glitches occurring with certain NPCs.
🔹 Adjusted the amount of required materials for crafting 5-Tier equipment helmets and shoes.
🔹 Changed amount of fine titanium required for crafting fine alloy armor helmet from 20 to 10.
🔹 Fixed frame drop issue that occurred near EMP towers.
🔹 Changed description for Steam achievement related to using Terrasite Transmitters in order to reflect their new functionality.
🔹 Fixed issue where vehicle explosions ignore player armor stats. Players should now receive less damage depending on the explosion stat of their equipped armor.

We’re closing the season, and starting fresh.

It’s a server with no upper limit on the server lifespan. There will be PvE and PvP options available, so settle down wherever you like!

We’re adding new functionality to the way that skills work. Successfully escaping your server’s terrafire event will give you a random perk. Each perk is a way of leveling up your character’s skills before logging into a server for the first time. 


Stay tuned for our full game note explaining everything new in the upcoming Season 3(v.0.4.0) update, where I'll be going into more detail about the features mentioned above and more!

Greetings from Orbis!
We’ll be releasing a big update next week with some new features that I’m sure you’ll all love, so this week is mostly some small balance changes and bug fixes to keep everything running smoothly on Ararat Island. Keep reading to learn what’s new this week in our 0.3.4 patch.

Transmitter Store Changes 🏷️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f31eed581ac213114d84780277be7fcec0d5b65a.png
Like I said in last week’s patch note, we’ve started changing out the contents of the transmitter store every week. We’ll be testing different changes over the coming weeks to balance the use of the transmitter store and to stop people from abusing it

This week we’ll be slightly reducing the number of high level weapons and armor that are available.



Recycler Recipe Changes 🔧
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/05d2b2d199f897c8a1c08c17b7dc49c1c0c6190c.png
Now that more high level equipment is purchasable in the transmitter store, we need to balance their recycling recipes to keep players from abusing the store to farm high level items.

1. Epic gear will no longer break down into superior terrasite.
2. Legendary gear (gold) will no longer break down into an energy core or a fine reactor.



Cyclops Melee Animation 👊
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c9dd7e109abe00e4141ee850dff0392deb449c8f.png

We realized that Uncheater wasn’t being uninstalled along with the game. We added code to our uninstall script to make sure that uncheater is being uninstalled.

There was a recent bug where players were able to use controllers to reduce the remaining lifespan of a server AFTER the terrafire countdown started. We’ve fixed the bug.

Greetings from Orbis, survivors!

This week’s patch is a bit smaller than usual. Our team has been hard at work making content for season 3 of Dysterra, so I hope you’ll understand that there are quite a few new things in the pipeline.

This update adds more variety to the items available in the Terrasite Transmitter. We’ve also made a tweak to the server selection UI, and added new functionality to the vehicle workshops F-hold menu.

Wednesday, April 26th
(PST) 00:00-02:00
(CET) 09:00-11:00

Changes to the Transmitter Store 🏷️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4f22752b74bda7a9491fcfddc38ea6d4734aa27a.png

Terrasite Transmitters are super useful. If you aren’t taking advantage of them, you’ve been missing out on easy access to quick jumps in game progression.

We’ve recently taken steps towards making them more accessible, and now we’re updating how the store itself works. From this week’s patch, the items in the store will be put on a weekly rotating schedule. Basic goods like sleeping bags, weapon scopes, and ammo will always be available, but an extra assortment of mid-high tier weapons and armor will switch out each week.

Note: Limited Ware will still change daily; Each day’s items will be picked randomly from a total set of 6 Legendary-tier items that will also be switched out every week during maintenance.

Other changes:
- Up to 100 of each pill may now be purchased (used to be 20)
- Up to 10 Microparts may now be purchased each week (was 2)



Pick up your Vehicle Workshop 🚗
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8aa8d77572d0ff11a3befc579684f9f803a248cc.png

You can now easily pick up your vehicle workshop by holding F while looking at it. Moving your workshop to a different location is now a piece of cake.



Game Version Revision 🚀
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1c057f4ce4ee46265b1a0c341450727c0b34aafe.png

For a lot of users, the game version looked like a bunch of random numbers that went up a little every week. We’ve added the official version numbers to the front so it’s more meaningful to non-technical survivors. If you’re curious, the 6 numbers on the end are called a “build number.” Every time one of our coders changes anything in the game and saves it, the number will go up by 1 (usually).

Before:
123456 
After:
0.3.2.123456

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/26766f4f1e266bed49b23fa5666d159ce5730eac.png

How did all of you enjoy our Blitz Mode event last weekend? Our team came together to play with you all, and we had a blast running into so many players and seeing you all enjoying the new content.

In this week's update, we're bringing more terrasite transmitters to the game to encourage their usage. We've also increased the drop rate of bolts and stone to make building easier and more efficient. In addition, the cost of bolts to repair all level 1 base parts has been removed. Keep reading for further details.

Update Maintenance Time:
Thursday, April 20th
(PST) 00:00-02:00
(CET) 09:00-11:00
(KST) 16:00-18:00



More Terrasite Transmitters 📡
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/13cd92d8cb9ab0dec9e0e0c7059960ee7177b154.png

In order to encourage the use of Terrasite Transmitters, we will replace the existing solar street lights with terrasite transmitters. You won’t have to fight with Hyena soldiers every time you want to buy something now.



Terrasite Transmitter Store🛍️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4f22752b74bda7a9491fcfddc38ea6d4734aa27a.png

We have added new items to the Terrasite Transmitter store. You can now purchase bolts for 15 pts each, motors for 25 pts, wires for 25 pts, sensors for 25 pts, and Lv.1 battery packs for 100 pts.



Mouse Wheel Weapon Change 🔫
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7f41919fdff0fc011c32b1171d52ff702c2a08aa.png
Players should now be able to switch to an empty hand when changing weapons while using the mouse wheel.



Increased Drop-rate for Bolts 🔩
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0b4fd8210f5bceadac5e32b3b84b36d9a5b7861e.png

Due to the addition of new roof building parts that will require more bolts, we will be increasing the drop rate of bolts by 10-15% for the following containers:


🔹 Fine Scrap Bin
🔹 Fine Toolbox
🔹 Fine Trash Compactor
🔹 Rusty Boat
🔹 Radiator
🔹 Trash Bags
🔹 Metal Separator
🔹 Junction Box
🔹 Transport Box
🔹 Trash Compactor



Increased Stone Collection Rate ⛰️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/cf13dd32564a6d24e07ed3cfbae0a4a38a47a293.png

We’ll be adding a new, angled roof to the game soon. In order to accommodate the addition of new roof building parts, we will be increasing the drop rate of stone by 30% for a number of items that includes stone and metal nodes, building debris, and terrapods.

No More Screw Removal Costs for Level 1 Building Parts 🔩
We have removed the cost of bolts to repair all level 1 base parts.



Other Changes
🔹 We’ve polished the animation for the Buggy Android when it spots a player.

🔹 We’ve fixed some issues with a couple of doors around the map.

🔹 When running a custom server, new log entries will now be added for connection failures, connection successes, anonymous logins, GSLT logins, save file loading, and dedicated server readiness.



Bug Fixes 🐛
This update contains several bug fixes for the game. Listed below are the details of the fixes included in this patch.

Gamepad 🎮
🔹 Fixed tooltip key guide error when opening inventory for the first time with a gamepad.

Building 🏗️

notes.title: (Major Update) Forgotten Heritage (Patch 0.3.0)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/18313fdcd3f409ab97d93519f3b1c17425f4e4c0.jpg
Greetings from Orbis!

The Orbis update is finally almost here! We’ve been sweating at the brow to make some great new content for you all.

Update Maintenance Time:
PST: Apr 6th, 21:00-01:00(Apr 7th)
CET: Apr 6th, 06:00-10:00
KST: Apr 6th, 14:00-18:00 

Our February update was all about the Hyenas, and this one is all about Orbis. You’ll get a new boss, new NPCs, new base parts, and of course some new guns. We’ve also improved radiation recovery speeds to make the game more accessible to new players.

Down below, I’ll talk about what’s going in, and what’s different, but I’m sure you’ll have some questions. Our team is active on Discord, and we’ll be happy to answer any questions you all have about the new content!

So to start:
Not a New Season 📈
I want to make sure everyone is on the same page:

This is not a new season. Rankings will not be reset.
This is not a new season. Rankings will not be reset.
This is not a new season. Rankings will not be reset.


The Heritage 🛸
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/618ca6b0c5c0d2a8400765e0bc5492718b81e2c2.jpg
It should be obvious to anyone on the servers that there’s a new presence on Ararat Island. This ship is the Heritage. It’s the mothership of a fleet of Orbis supply ships that ferry materials between islands. You can fight your way to the portal that leads inside, and get some nifty new items and materials for upgrading your base, armor, or weapons.

Finding the entrance/portal is up to you. Good luck!


New Orbis Enemies 🤖
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/dba033deb61294c739f1c56a1a2e8d203d6feb1e.jpg
The Orbis Heavy Gunner is the key to unlocking a whole new set of recipes! Aim for his weak spots and steal his “core” to craft one the new legendary weapons featured below. He’s waiting for you!

You’ll also find a new type of Orbis robot as well as some Advanced Hacking Crates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/eba9c3e4bd3d7f01dd05ace63525d9135757d887.jpg


Secure Area: Maintenance Bays 🔒
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7b76c2a58d4d34321099354f6dad3c25082cc8c2.jpg
We’re adding some new secure areas to the game. You can think of them like a toned-down loot room where you can find exclusive items for recipes. There are a few of these secure areas, each with slightly different loot inside, so keep an eye out for maintenance bay keys!


2 New Weapons! 🔫

We’ve got two new great guns in this update: our non-legendary tier rocket launcher (Blue Tier), and a legendary assault rifle that uses a new type of ammo to give blast damage that should render most shields useless.

FFM-202
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0f0ace63d6b1ea8fc78c76a71eb7a7ae27bd0ded.jpg
This is our first non-legendary (blue-tier) rocket launcher. The FFM-202, also referred to as the Flashfire, is an entry launcher for survivors that are looking to loot with style, but don’t want the expense and hassle that comes with maintaining a legendary-tier weapon.

The FFM-202 uses Rocket Ammo instead of Rocket Cartridges. This means you won’t have to craft high level ammo for a lower level weapon.

Damage Type: Explosion (= full damage to Hyena & Orbis)
Damage: 80 dmg
Building Dmg: 125%
Piercing: 4%
Full dmg up to: 65 meters

Rocket Ammo Recipe (2 rockets):
💥 Fine Metal x 1
💥 Fine Blasting Agent x 1


TFT-K7
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/42f48734355c3ad2d3bc150814afdbaf80f6cbe5.jpg
A legendary (yellow-tier) assault rifle. The TFT-K7(referred to in-house as the Painstaker) is our first gun to use explosive ammo. While it may shoot a bit slower than other rifles, it gives blast damage, allowing it to damage enemies through shields. With the new 

Exploding Ammo is what makes the TFT-K7 so unique and powerful.

Damage Type: Explosion (= full damage to Hyena & Orbis)
Damage: 31 dmg
Building Dmg: 10%
Full dmg up to: 55 meters

Explosive Ammo Recipe (20 cartridges)
💥 Fine Metal x 2
💥 Fine Blasting Agent x 2


Automatic Mining! ⛰️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2b24aeaae170734837fb1a2186b765f8738e62f1.jpg

Are you tired of spending your time gathering basic materials when you could be out there fighting baddies and farming high level parts for your next raid? Well now you can get your terrasite, stone, and minerals mined automatically for you. You’ll need to explore the new secure areas (Maintenance Bays) in order to find their parts, but it’s definitely worth the trouble for anyone who’s looking to save time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d583ed7c4c8226a0f13703b93949c2fffd17fb31.jpg

There are 3 types of miner, and each is upgradable to level 2. Level 1 miners will give you only the basic element at a slow rate, but level 2 miners will give you the element at a faster rate, with the occasional high level material included in the output.


Automatic Cultivators 🌱
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9b80043ee4ed3e703b43d16ff8997736ec858fd3.jpg
While you're automatically farming your terrasite, stone, and minerals, you can also be growing your own food inside your base. We’ve got three separate cultivators with multiple upgradable tiers that you can use to grow most of your basic dietary necessities: protein, vegetables, and fungi.

You’ll get spores from mushrooms, serum from animals, and seeds from plants. You can place these in the cultivators to grow them into the full versions. There’s a chance to get more spores, serums, and seeds, so you’ll often end up with a little more than you expect.

You’ll still need to go hunting for food and mushrooms, but these cultivators will help you to get more food in less time. The level 2 versions have better rates, so upgrading will save you more time, but not completely eliminate the need to go foraging.


Trophies 🏆
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/249b0d5fbfe1c5d419b94442f0bf6d6e6f3c956c.jpg
Show your friends, or unwelcome looters, just how tough you are! Cyclops and Juggernauts are the scariest non-bosses in the game. Starting in this update, you’ll often find a “Cyclops Shape Data” item or a “Juggernaut Shape Data” Item when you kill the respective mob. You can combine 10 of these to form a silver figurine, and then combine 5 silver figurines to craft a golden figurine.

New Building Layouts 🏠🏢🏣🏡🏘️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/dc0e2b6b0321847702fa118ed47491c93e048006.jpg
For all of you farmers out there, we’ve updated the layouts of several building types on the outskirts of the island, and we’ve replaced a large number of buildings with brand new buildings to add variety to your time out in the field gathering supplies.


Level 3 Orbis Container 💎
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c20005714b95d8e9f82af5006e34bac7f9389952.jpg
We’re also releasing a level 3 Orbis Container. This container’s different because it’s our first “grab-bag” style container. You’ll have a chance to get new higher level skins, but there will always be a chance of getting a skin that’s also in one of the lower level containers. Don’t worry, though. If you already have a skin, you’ll receive a portion of the TP you spent on the container.


Stronger Bunker Mobs 🕸️
We’ve added some high-value loot to the bunker, so we decided to increase the HP and attack power of bunker mobs across the board.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/558b12c7649e77c0c101d79e2b3ceb58da5bfbfe.jpg

Variant
HP:                      580 ➡️ 1000
Regular Attack:     30 ➡️ 50
Downward Attack: 45 ➡️ 56
Dash Attack:         50 ➡️ 60

Retcher
HP:                 175 ➡️ 300
Regular Attack: 15 ➡️ 20


Other Changes 📒
🔹 Increased amount of terrasite received from Fine Terrasite Nodes from (20-22) to (25-27)

🔹 Added new items to the journal

🔹 Eating raw broccoli reduces your HP by 3 pts. (was 10 pts)

🔹 New base-parts give players skill XP.

🔹 New base-parts contribute to rankings.

🔹 Faster Recovery from Radiation: 3 points/sec. (was 1 point/sec)

notes.title: Patch Preview: Enter? Or Walk away?
notes.notes:
Greetings from Orbis!

In this week's patch, Ararat Island's game mechanics are being refined to create a more engaging and challenging experience. We're redesigning doors, we’re making a change to the Meteochamber elevator, and mobs will now be able to walk away from a fight.

🚶🏿‍♂️ Should I stay or should I go?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/608d391ae84e6a6a80b2880543245d95c96b6eca.jpg

With so many types of areas on Ararat Island, some are bound to be easier while others are going to be harder. We’ve decided to redesign doors so they show the expected difficulty of the area.
Difficulties range from Very Easy to Very Hard, so if you’re a beginner, you’ll know to stay in places that have the word “easy” in their description. 


🚪 Change to Meteochamber Elevator
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/99217e2dec13e049d9b9aabe6fec0838030345da.jpg

The elevator in the Meteochamber now requires a special key to operate, which is obtained from the Stomper in the final area.

Users must retrieve the key after calling the elevator in order to ride it to the upper level. However, the key will expire one hour after it is obtained, rendering it unusable. This change is being implemented to prevent unintended methods of clearing the Meteochamber.


🚶🏿‍♂️ Just walk away.
There were instances where mobs weren’t able to attack players for whatever reason.  That’s why we're teaching mobs how to walk away from a fight. This way, if you’re on your roof and some cyclops come walking by, they will run away once they realize they can’t get to you.


🐞 Bugs
🔹Some resources were hidden under dirt. We dug them up and dusted them off.
🔹Upon dying, players would sometimes only see the final piece of damage they received. We killed that error.
🔹We fixed facility skills so they don’t affect a sphere, but instead affect a cylinder that includes above and below ground. (This means you could be affected while in the Bunker or the Hyena Den.)
🔹Custom Server log improvements. We fixed some errors with locations and UIDs concerning resource boxes.
🔹Fixed an issue with the delta plant’s facility skill.


As always, we hope you'll like what we’ve done. We’re always striving to make Dysterra an enjoyable game for everyone!

-Director K

notes.title: (Patch Note) Longer Server Lifespans
notes.notes:
Greetings from Orbis!

In this week's patch, we'll be introducing various balance changes. One shotgun's recipe will be updated, while the other will receive a significant boost in power to better reflect its effectiveness. Radiation protection for hazmat suits and rad suits will be readjusted to provide more reasonable levels of defense. We'll also be extending world lifespans and introducing buffs to turrets, addressing concerns regarding their effectiveness in defending against off-line raiding.


📒 Shotgun Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/48e6997b4500368ab426cbdcee7ebfda1af031e8.jpg

In the next update, we're making some changes to two shotguns in the game.

RF-9 Shotgun
To better reflect the RF-9's power, we're upgrading its tier from Tier-3 to Tier-4. We're also adjusting the recipe for crafting the RF-9 to better match its new tier.

P-38 Shotgun (pictured above)
We're increasing the number of pellets in the P-38 shotgun cartridge from 8 to 12, and making some adjustments to its damage to better balance it. 

Before: 8 pellets of 16 dmg(each) = 128
Now: 12 pellets of 14 dmg(each) = 168


📒 Radiation Suit Re-leveling
I admit it. We nerfed radiation protection too much when introducing the new Rad suits. The new tier-2 rad suits will now add up to 65% protection while the original tier-3 hazmat suits will total 90%.

We’re also increasing max radiation resistance from 100 to 200.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/87ff12db3ba005d550a85492bcd91dbdffc93129.jpg


📒 New Items in the Terra Shop
We’re also adding two new items to the Lobby’s Terra Shop.

One is the 3-stack shelf. For everyone that’s tired of using columns and foundations to build makeshift shelves, these are what you’ve been waiting for! They are exactly 1/4 the size of a foundation square, and can stack up to 3 layers. I hope you like them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7896e9ef4b52e5ebb70270e606db40f075ed7456.jpg


The other item is a mushroom head lamp. You can install it on a foundation or on the ground.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/33454ae10f2551e2fe81c36a0ecaa015cf1f22ca.jpg


📒 Improved Turret Functionality
We are constantly seeking ways to improve Dysterra's balance, and one area that requires attention is the effectiveness of turrets. Although turrets are the main defense against off-line raiding, their limited range has made them vulnerable to long-distance attacks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0bd356621ae8e0d6b3a6df13ba00f4f056aa61a5.jpg

To address this issue, we are introducing an update that will change the raiding dynamics for turrets. Only high-level melee weapons (IGX-1 & IGXX-100), rockets, and blast mines will be capable of damaging turrets. While this approach may require further balancing in the future, it is a significant step towards realizing our initial vision of turrets as an anti-raiding weapon.

Additionally, we are increasing the interceptor turret's health from 700 HP to 5000 HP to enhance its defensive capabilities.


📒Changes to World Lifespans
We’ve consistently heard complaints that the minimum lifespans for servers were too short, so we’ve increased the beginning lifespan for servers from 14 to 28 days.

Changes:
Prior Lifespan: 2 weeks IRL -> 4 weeks IRL (672 days in-game)
Shortest Lifespan: 10 days IRL -> 14 days IRL (336 days in-game)
Longest Lifespan: 28 days IRL -> 30 days IRL (720 days in-game)

That’s all for this week. Have fun out there!
-Director K

notes.title: (Patch Note) Base Decor and More - Update Preview (03.02.2023)
notes.notes:
Greetings from Orbis!

We’ve got a jam-packed patch for all of you soon-to-be interior designers. 

If you’ve been wanting more ways to personalize your base, we’ve got what you’ve been waiting for. 

But if you’re not ready to tackle interior decorating, we’ve got 3 new sets of armor, 9 new gun attachments, turret improvements, and raiding buffs to a couple melee weapons.

📒 Decorate your base!
Starting from this patch, you’ll be able to turn that cold, dark base of yours into a warm, inviting home. 

With item recipes that you can acquire in the game lobby’s “Terra Shop”, you’ll be able to decorate and organize your base in new and fun ways.

Aside from the bed and the shelves, all of the decor in this patch is non-functional. We plan to wall shelves soon that will also serve as a place to store items.

These item recipes are unavailable by default. You’ll have to use your terrapoints to unlock their crafting recipes.

Reminder: Terrapoints can be earned daily by logging in, and they’ll also be paid out weekly to players according to their ranking tier. They are different from the points you receive when transmitting terrasite.

Here’s one way you might decorate your base:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3ecdcc15dc88eaedca368ebb2ff07d11b3fc68eb.jpg

And here’s another:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c26fc9f57038814824d1e3b1779031904538779a.jpg

📒 Color-code your chests
You’ll also find three new colors of chests that you can unlock.

So for those of you that enjoy visually organizing your chests, this should open up quite a few new ways to keep track of which items are in which chest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7896e9ef4b52e5ebb70270e606db40f075ed7456.jpg

📒 Rad new armor!
Hazmat suits give you 50% radiation protection, making them a solid Tier 3 choice for survivors that often visit the Orbis bases. The only issue is that they’re a bit difficult to craft.

For players that are just getting started, we have 3 new suits for you to try out: the Cryo Suit, the Pyro Suit, and the Rad Suit. These Tier 2 suits will only give you 30% protection against their respective elements, but it should be enough for those of you venturing into dangerous territory.

From left to right: Rad Suit, Cryo Suit, Pyro Suit
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e4585824600a09f863273294957719f2d94ec3ab.jpg

📒 9 New Gun Attachments
We’re adding 3 new compensators, 3 new silencers, and 3 new vertical grips.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/28ebe13bdc34dc21ecc1620dec1f34496adee176.jpg

Each type of attachment has 4 levels for you to choose from. The existing standard attachments are now “level 2”. We’re also hoping to add even more attachments some day. Keep in mind that we had to adjust the stats of existing attachments to fit with the new number of attachments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/abfc0554df67ce8adb54df3d3f2e35ec5f20ff27.jpg

📒 2 existing weapons can now have attachments
The Shotgun RF-9 and the Assault Rifle TAR-1A can now have a muzzle. So feel free to choose between a silencer or a compensator the next time you’re gearing up.

📒 Name and Stat Changes to two melee weapons
Raiding has mostly been secluded to mines and rockets, but we’re hoping to open that up more with the repurposing of battle hammers into “siege hammers.”  

The Siege Hammer IGX-1(battle hammer) will give 100% damage to building parts, while the Siege Hammer IGXX-100 will give 200% damage to building parts.

Battle Hammer → SIEGE HAMMER IGX-1
Great Battle Hammer → SIEGE HAMMER IGXX-100
(Names are still subject to change)

📒 Changes to Existing Recipes
As we try to make raiding more approachable, we also want to make rockets cheaper.

We’ve changed the recipe from
5 Fine Metal, 5 Fine Wires, 1 Superior Blasting Agent
to
2 Fine Metal, 2 Fine Wires, 1 Superior Blasting Agent

📒 Turret Improvements
We can’t make raiding easier without considering base defense.
We’ve also changed turrets so that as you upgrade a turret, each level has faster bullets and higher accuracy with the exception of the shotgun turret because it’s made for close encounters like being hidden inside one’s base.

📒 Teleporting Improvements
When leaving the hyena den or bunker, players were plopped onto the beach. 

While we changed the location for better convenience, we also realized that players may spawn next to a not-so friendly mob, or another player might catch them off guard. 

That’s why we instituted a 10 second window of invincibility when teleporting anywhere.

We’ve also adjusted teleport destinations when leaving the bunker. 

You’ll now arrive somewhere near the main road(where the bunker entrances are) as opposed to being dropped on the beach. We’re hoping this should shorten commute times by a significant amount.

📒 Changes to Item Drops
The following containers/mobs now have a chance to contain the following.

Hyena Secure Crate:
2 superior Blasting Agents OR 4 Fine Blasting Agents

Hyena Transport Box: 
2 Superior Blasting Agents

Hyena Heavy Buster: 
6 Superior Blasting Agents

Hyena Heavy Assaulter: 
2 superior Blasting Agents OR 4 Fine Blasting Agents

📒 Bug Fixes
We’ve also made several bug fixes.  You can see them all in our update note once it’s up.
 But here are a couple of the bigger fixes.

⚪ Items weren’t going into the forge. Now they do.
⚪ Shotgun damage was sometimes showing as ‘0’. It should display accurately now.
⚪ There were occasions of players losing building core privileges when their core somehow overlapped with another core. We added some code to prevent this from happening.

Remember that this isn’t everything. 
You can always read the update note to know about every single thing we’ve changed in this patch.

I’ll see you on Friday with the Dev Note.
-Director K

notes.title: (Patch Note) Quality of Life Improvements - Update Preview (02.22.2023)
notes.notes:
Greetings from Orbis!

For all of you amazing survivors out there, we have an exciting patch for you this week. This week’s patch will make everyone’s life easier with instant shots, larger player inventories, (mostly) cheaper repair recipes, increased durability for ALL weapons and armor, larger ammo stacks, and more.

📒 All Status-Effect Shots Are Instant
Shots are a big part of Dysterra. Whether it’s a shot to your enemy’s head or an anti-radiation shot. We made status-effect related shots take effect instantly so you won’t have to wait for your shot to take effect. No more crossing your fingers hoping for your radiation shot to take effect before you lose that last bar of health!

📒 Removal of all Snipers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a7e6a9ecfb01dc87be86a7ca967a98fe1aa2660d.jpg

Snipers were a novel and fun addition to the game when we first implemented them, but over time, they became more of a nuisance than a fun mob you can loot. After long and hard deliberation, we’re taking ASKR snipers as you know them out of the game for the foreseeable future. We’re in the process of developing something else that will add some action to your farming ventures. But in the meantime, you’ll only have to worry about bears and the occasional cyclops when you’re wandering the wilderness.

📒 New Terrashop Recipes
Some of you may remember Christmas Trees and the introduction of potted firs as a decorative item. We’re adding a potted cactus in this week’s patch along with a light stand that you can easily turn on and off. Be careful around the cactus, though! You’ll get pricked if you bump into it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8476144869dbaca08aade42b0b08ac564c4b226f.jpg

You can use your terrapoints to purchase their recipes in the game’s lobby. We’re planning to add more decor recipes in the near future as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a3498afc25d522bb51a89e5c968ad7f678956e0e.jpg

📒 Forge Refinement Modifications
Forging items was always a straightforward process: put in a basic item, receive a higher level item. We have some new items that don’t fit so easily into that mould, so we’re adding some randomization to what you get when refining terrasite.

Terrasite Lumps now have a chance to be refined into terrasite, fine terrasite, or a superior terrasite lump (refinable into superior terrasite).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6473e4dce174483f8fd4c960c99f89075113fe0f.jpg

You’ll see the possible results when you drop your material into the forge. Please keep in mind that each refined item has a different chance of dropping.

📒 Easier Inventory Management
We’ve taken several steps to alleviate the struggles of inventory management.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8bd24b10a2650eb56665a59c87d29d8c3b9c64d3.jpg

1. We’ve increased inventory sizes for all players from 30 to 36.
2. The inventory upgrade skill now has 5 levels: 2/4/6/9/12
3. The maximum inventory possible is 48 slots. (up from 40).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a02b1d5052992d710288e6ab4228a02a0801f062.jpg

📒 Simplified Repair Recipes
We were trying to make repair recipes reflect the original recipes for items, but we realized it would be easier for players if recipes were more straightforward. 

Repair recipes are now simply divided into 3 types: weapons, fiber-based armor, and metal-based armor. Each type has the same recipe for all items of the same tier.

For example: 
Tier 2 weapons: 1 microparts
Tier 2 fiber-based armor: 1 silicon fabric
Tier 2 metal-based armor: 1 fine metal

📒 Repairing in the field requires energy
On the other hand, we want to encourage players to use a repair bench, and not solely repair items while in the field. We’ve added an energy cost to field repairs of items respective of the items tier, so bring some extra batteries if you think you’ll need to repair your equipment in the middle of a mission.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0f278e0940b31daa55db5cf114a5e615123be05e.jpg

For those of you who don’t know: You can right click items while they’re in your inventory to repair them. It’s the same cost as using your repair bench, but you’ll also spend energy in the process. This isn’t a big deal if you’re using lower tier weapons, but if you’re using a higher tier weapon, you’ll have to think tactically before doing a repair.

📒 Increased durability across the board
While we were modifying the recipes, we also decided to increase the durability for all weapons and armor by 50%. If the durability of something was 300, it’s now 450. If it was 200, it’s now 300. This should make your life a bit easier!

📒 Larger Ammo Stacks
As part of the battle against inventory management, we’re also increasing the stack sizes for all types of ammo.
Light Ammo: 300 -> 500
Energy Ammo: 300 -> 500
Shotgun Ammo: 100 -> 180
Sniper Ammo: 50 -> 100
Rocket Cartridges: 3 -> 5

📒 Meteochamber Modifications
Some players were abusing the Meteochamber. We’ve taken steps to make NPC spawn camping in the Meteochamber less productive.

📒 Changes to Raiding Weapons
Land mines have been the primary base attack weapon for quite some time, but we want the rocket launcher to be a useful base-attack weapon as well. We’ve made some changes to make it more useful in a raid:

1. We increased building damage for the Rocket Launcher UWR-102 from 100% to 200% building damage. (The Energy Rocket Launcher is primarily an anti-personnel weapon, so it’s still 50% building damage.)

2. It’s possible to craft rocket launchers without conquering a facility. You can get core tetrads through random drops in the Hyena Den when defeating bosses of each area. It’ll require a few run-throughs and a bit of luck, but you’ll gain access to high level items that once were only obtainable through facilities.

3. If you noticed the change to repair recipes above, it also applies to rocket launchers. So you no longer need ultra-rare items to repair your rocket launchers. A tier-5 weapon repair will cost you: 1 superior metal, 1 superior microparts, & 1 superior terrasite. It’ll also cost you 60 energy if you’re repairing it in the field.

4. If you run out of rockets, we’ve also increased the building damage of blast mines. So they’re still as useful as ever.

That’s it for this week’s patch note.

We’re trying hard to listen to our survivors and always change the game in a positive direction. Constructive feedback is always welcome, so be sure to leave a comment on our Discord server if you have an opinion about what else needs improving.

See you all on Discord!
- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Tutorial Improvement and New Items - Update Preview [02.15.2023]
notes.notes:
Greetings from Orbis!

Things have finally settled down in our offices following the push to get Season 2 ready on time. 
We’re still going to release consistent patches, and we’re definitely going to sprinkle in new content whenever we can. 

This week we have mostly quality of life changes, but also some new items that can be recycled into very useful crafting materials.

📒 Quests wait until you’re done fighting.

    I know most of you have tried the tutorial (known in-game as the mission guide). 

There were occasions when Vanessa would start talking about your next mission while you were in the middle of a fight. Nobody wants to be distracted when there’s a gun pointed at their head.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/56131914ab2e40e33457630e441b2cebd5d59675.jpg

That’s why we’ve added a new condition to any base-building related quests:
A new quest will not be introduced while NPCs are targeting you. 

The game now lets you finish what you’re doing before Vanessa starts telling you what’s next on your agenda. Let us know if there are any instances where it needs further adjustment.

📒 Changed some drops
    In this patch, we’ll be adding a couple new useful items:

◾ Metal Specimen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6c41aca0e100130f4c98cde9249b65eb8b128efc.gif

◾ Titanium Specimen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9b8f071a360a2840f8e09ab0652420dc6285fb38.gif

◾ Lithium Specimen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4efeeb54c2d224b9a3c724ec8c8964993b4521ad.gif

While Ararat’s facilities are currently battlegrounds, they were originally for research. We’re hoping to include more world building in small ways like this for the foreseeable future. You’ll be able to find them in the Bunker, as well as when defeating a juggernaut(instead of the RF-9 shotgun it used to drop).

These items can be broken down at a recycler into very high level and useful materials.

📒 Newly Purchasable Items!
    Work smart, not hard! Instead of farming for items all day, just buy what you need at a terrasite transmitter. You can find them next to most Hyena portals(marked on your map), or you can install one in your home. All you need to do is transmit some terrasite up to Orbis for some terrapoints, and then use those terrapoints to buy whatever’s on sale at the moment.

Newly added items include:

 Medical Shot Lv. 1 
 Anti-Radiation Shot Lv. 1
 Cooling Shot
 Heating Shot
 Light Ammo
 Energy Ammo
 Shotgun Shell
 Sniper Ammo
 Frag Grenade

    With the need for mutant mushrooms to make anti-radiation shots, this should be a nice way to stock up when you’re in a rush. But remember that you can only purchase a limited amount of each item, and items may rotate in and out of stock, so it’s good to buy things before you need them.

📒 Bug Fixes

Buildings
✅ Base parts weren’t snapping together. Fixed it.

Enemies
✅ Enemies were popping through walls. They shouldn’t anymore.
✅ Animals weren’t making sounds while walking. You should hear bears sneaking up on you now.
✅ Animals and enemies weren’t moving their feet correctly when turning, or they seemed to be walking on ice. We put our foot down and stopped the problem.

Inventory
✅ Some people lost their protocols while trying to drag their protocol to the repair bench while their inventory was full. That won’t happen any more.

Other fixes
✅ Some containers where floating up in the air. We bolted them down so they’ll stay in place.

UI
✅ We fixed several small UI issues across the board.


Okay. That’s a wrap for this week.
I’ll see you on the servers!
- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Our first Season 2 patch - Update Preview [02.07.2023]
notes.notes:
Adjusted title due to the update on the patch schedule - 02.07.2023
[hr][/hr]
Welcome to Dysterra!

We hope everyone had a fantastic time during the free weekend of Dysterra! It's been a true joy to welcome so many new players to the game, and we're grateful for their contributions in the forums. With their fresh perspectives and insightful feedback, we're able to continue improving the game and deliver an even better gaming experience. Thank you to all of our players, old and new, for your support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1054c0ecbab269a0295da95f3af1122705c31208.jpg

As developers, our goal is to provide the best gaming experience possible in Dysterra. We’re continuously gathering feedback, analyzing gameplay data, and experimenting with new features and improvements. We’re dedicated to fixing bugs, balancing gameplay, and adding new content.

We appreciate your patience and your feedback as we work to make Dysterra better. Although some technical issues may take longer to resolve, please let us know if an issue is taking too long. Your feedback is a large part of our development process, and player feedback feedback lets us know what we’re doing right(or wrong).

With that said, this week’s patch is mostly aimed at fixing some common issues addressing drop rates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/296692c683f8997f6b59ba2e36cf038c6aa561bf.jpg

📒 More Mutant Mushrooms
Exciting news regarding radiation shots!
We're adding nearly 100 new mutant mushroom spawning locations to help players craft more radiation shots when they need them. Raiding Orbis bases should be much easier now.


📒 Changes to Item Drop Rates
We're constantly adding new and exciting items to the game to keep things fresh and interesting for our players. But the influx of new items in our Season 2 update comes with the need to maintain balance in our drop tables. In order to ensure players can consistently obtain the items they're seeking when farming, we're taking the necessary steps to rebalance several of our container drop tables.

We understand that obtaining specific items can be an important part of the gaming experience, and we want to make sure that players are able to do so in a fair and consistent manner. By rebalancing the drop tables, we aim to strike a balance between excitement and accessibility, providing players with a more enjoyable and rewarding experience overall.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/fffa3f7171881d19f9ea22c4a60728eeb5ea2fdd.jpg

📒 Stronger Lv.1 Batteries
Batteries are now harder to craft with the added requirement of Lithium, meaning they are harder to get when you need them. To compensate for this, we’ve decided to enhance the power of Lv.1 batteries, increasing their energy points from 20 to 25.


📒 Optimizations
In response to single-player feedback, we're making adjustments to the number of resource nodes in single-player mode to better suit the solo experience. This update aims to provide a more optimized and enjoyable experience for players who prefer to journey through the game without other players attacking them.


📒 AI Optimization
To enhance overall gameplay, we’ve made some improvements to AI pathfinding. These updates ensure that AI characters can navigate the game world more effectively and efficiently, allowing them to reach their desired destinations with greater accuracy.


📒 Bug Fixes
◾ The recycler was spitting out the wrong items for a couple of materials. We’ve fixed it.

◾ We’ve patched up the Bunker to make sure people don’t get stuck in places they shouldn’t.

◾ A few facilities had an issue where the final boss wasn’t spawning. We had a chat with the NPCs, and they’ll be showing up for work from now on.

◾ A couple players weren’t able to rejoin their teams after leaving them. You should be able to play in full teams of 4 with no issue now.

◾ There was an issue with building restrictions for bases with multiple users where players would suddenly not be able to interact with a part of their base. That issue should now be a thing of the past.

That’s a wrap for this week.
Be sure to buy the game while it’s still on sale if you enjoyed it!

-Director K
