notes.title: Patch Note: What’s in Season 2? - Update Preview [02.01.2023]
notes.notes:
Greetings from Orbis!!

We’re so close to the update !! We’re in full crunch at our offices and are doing our best to make sure everything is as perfect as possible. There’s a lot to unpack in this update, so I’ll fit as much in as possible.

A quick rundown of what’s in store: 2 brand new underground areas to explore (one PvP, and one PvE solo area), new map functionality, 22 new recovery items, 3 new guns, 2 new melee weapons, 4 new sets of armor, a new ammo type, new Hyena NPCs, new mutant NPCs, a turret buff, level 4 base parts, streaming mode, debuffs to base protection, and big changes to how global rankings are calculated.

We’re still in early access, but I really think this Season 2 update will bring us a lot closer to where we want the game to be. I’d love to hear your feedback so be sure to head over to our discord and mention one of the devs (@Dev_Armond, etc.) and let us know what needs fixin’!

📒Two New Areas to Explore

◾ The Bunker
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a473139e050a10906fd6a826296718be72b8146a.jpg

The first underground area is a free-for-all space where you will very likely run into other players. If you go deep enough, you’ll run into new mutants that may just end your exploration if you’re not careful. There are entrances all around the map, so you’ll never have to look far to find a way in. Once you’re in, however, you can’t turn back around and run away. You’ll need to find the exit if you want to keep all of your stuff, so be careful.

◾ The Hyena Den

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/84b59b7a0711501c53deab455e34e87c3306c209.jpg

The second underground area is a private instance where you won’t run into anyone else. You can test your mettle against new Hyena bosses, and improve your gear when you’re done with all the new loot you picked up. Like the Bunker, you’ll have to go through it and find the exit if you want to live to tell the tale of your bravery.

📒 Tutorial Updates
The tutorial(known in-game as the Mission Guide) is usually the fastest way to understand the basics of any game. We've made several small improvements to make the tutorial more effective at assisting new players. The largest one is an item frequency map overlay that will show where an item is likely to be found. If you don’t know where you find something, this should help point you in the right direction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e57191537043e93148ca0565668a8020952d1146.jpg

It’s also available in the journal. If you’re farming for a specific item or two, you can find the item in your journal, and check the “Display on world map” button. You’ll then be able to see the item’s drop locations on your map.

Note: Items are randomly distributed into their respective container(s), so you’ll have to display the item’s corresponding container(s) on your map when you’re looking for it. And in case you’re wondering, you can display multiple container distributions on your map simultaneously.

📒 UI Upgrades - Skill Level Progress
You can now see your skill level progress more easily. We’ve added a progress bar to your hot key menu to make it more convenient to check your progress to unlocking that next skill point.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c566dcee47c07849db76a28ae8cc5d74227dcae6.jpg

📒 Increased Crafting Times
Crafting differences before were small, but we’ve increased the crafting times for weapons and armor to reflect their corresponding tier levels.

Level 1 : 30 seconds
Level 2 : 1 minute
Level 3 : 4 minutes
Level 4 : 6 minutes
Level 5 : 10 minutes

📒 22 New Recovery Items
We’ve added 22 new items to help you recover from all types of status effects. Some notable items are:

◾Orbis Battery: You can reduce system overload cooldown time at the cost of a small amount of HP.
◾Pocket Whiskey: You’ll heal bleeding and fractures, but lose some HP.
◾Battery Pack Lv.3: double the charge of a Lv.2 Battery
◾Vitamin Drink: Heals health
◾Trauma Pack: Heals health, bleeding, and fractures

📒 3 New Guns

◾ EL-1 Pistol (Bellatrix)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/bd3216874787c4c4a75318c1445407568812b525.jpg

A stronger tier-3 pistol. It may look like it packs a weaker punch than the tier-2 energy pistol, but its larger magazine and the ability to burst fire 3 shots at a time will make your enemies think twice about chasing after you.

◾ P-38 Shotgun (Tirador)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/48e6997b4500368ab426cbdcee7ebfda1af031e8.jpg

A cheaper double-barreled shotgun for players that need a shotgun quick. You only have two shots before you need to reload, so it’s best for picking off enemies one by one, or as a backup weapon when you’re in a jam.

◾ TAR-1 Assault Rifle (Thundershower)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f40c2c38dbf9788aeda562170c7af0bfb1c64c94.jpg

This tier-3 rifle combines the power of a regular assault rifle with the firing speed of a submachine gun. It has fewer rounds than a basic tier-2 submachine gun, but each bullet gives more damage.

📒 2 New Melee Weapons

◾ Battle Hammer

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f635e65f0c102f60bdb909392036e52e95020a97.jpg

The Battle Hammer is a craftable, and repairable!, weapon that is stronger than a cyclops claw. It may swing slowly, but each hit will give your opponent the fracture status effect. The more hits you land, the more slowly your opponent will move, allowing you to get more hits in!

◾ Great Battle Hammer

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/daaafbd0eaf95d50670ede0ae0a6f49c941a33cd.jpg

A stronger version of the basic battle hammer, this hammer gives the fracture effect, slowing your opponent’s escape. You could also use it on powerful enemies to slow their approach and use that extra time to reload or heal.

📒 New Ammo Type
Sniper Ammo. Ammo strategies in the game needed some complexity, so we’ve added a separate ammo for snipers.

📒 4 New Sets of Armor (4 pieces each)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/69bcd590cf39709c42cc6e6786f5493ca2835894.jpg
(From left to right: Nanite, Mirage, Eisen, Aegis)

We’ve added four new sets of tier-4 armor. Each 4-piece set has its own strengths and weaknesses, so choose carefully when you’re dressing for your next outing.

📒 New Hyena NPC: Hyena Heavy Assaulter

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/471fd10d2a19e2adc72b6f24c1a582452f3a237a.jpg

We’ve also added a new Hyena spot event. In a small number of bases, you’ll run across the Hyena Heavy Assaulter. We hope he’ll add more variety to the PvE landscape of Dysterra.

📒 Stronger Turrets = Better Offline Defense
We’ve strengthened turret HP across the board to improve offline base defense. Some turrets now have over double their initial HP, so don’t be afraid to add a few more to your base before you log off!

📒 New Building Ingredients
We wanted to add some depth to the building process. Before, you could build everything with basic farmable resources, but now you’ll need screws to hold things together. You can’t craft them, so you’ll have to go find them in lower tier buildings if you want to add something to your base.

📒 Level 4 Housing Upgrade
We’ve added a level 4 upgrade option to most base building components. We’re hoping the level 4 design let’s people know that you have a lot of valuable goodies inside your base. I think it’ll be more fun to let you see for yourself in-game what a level four base looks like!

📒 Streaming Mode

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7ff00e17ec8d926cc58752fedbef426545dddd18.jpg

To make playing Dysterra as stress-free as possible for all of our amazing streamers, we’ve added a “Streaming Mode” to the options menu.

Currently, activating it will do three things: replace all player nicknames with false nicknames, hide server names in the lobby server menu, and also hide the location of your core.

📒 Base Protection Changes!
Base protection is a great way for new or casual players to get used to the game without fear of losing progress due to offline raiding. The feature seemed a bit OP, so we made it so that you can’t do anything productive while your base protection is active.

That means you can’t craft, recycle, repair, open a chest, or even open a door. You can turn base units like electric floors on and off, and you can charge your core with any terrasite on your character.
But don’t worry! You won’t deactivate it if you click on something by accident. If you try to do something, you’ll get a pop up notification asking if you’d like to disable base protection.

📒 Cooldown times reflect usage
In our last patch, cooldown times for base protection were locked at 6 hours. We don’t want people waiting 6 hours if they press the button by accident. That’s why we also planned a dynamic cooldown time with a minimum cooldown of 2 hours. So if you have an initial protection time of 14 hours, and you turn it off after 7 hours(50% of total protection time), you’ll only have to wait 3 hours to turn it back on again(50% of total cooldown time).

📒 PvE / PvP Global Rankings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/337eba8e22a86520223bcb23a555f6b6e6d1a792.jpg

During the course of a season, a player might join several different server types. We want a player’s global ranking to reflect their overall skill in the game, but we also don’t want to discourage players from trying out PvE or Hardcore if they feel like it.

That’s why we’ve added weights to the points.
PvE will be scored in the global rankings exactly the same way as it is now.
PvP will have a x1.5 weight on any points earned.
Hardcore will have a x2.3 weight on any points earned.

These numbers are a starting point. We might fiddle with the exact weights down the line if it seems necessary, but for the most part they should stay similar to where they are now.

That was a lot!! But there’s even more that I didn’t mention, so be sure to hop on the servers and see what’s new and how much has changed in the game.

Good luck out there!
- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Addition to Housing Protection - Update Preview [01.26.2023]
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

Many of you may have tried out the housing protection feature we added in our last update. The housing protection feature we put out last week wasn’t the full vision of what we initially planned, so we’re putting the last of our planned features in this week.

We’re actively listening to your feedback and are planning to modify housing protection to better suit player needs, but we wanted to push out the last of our initial design first. I’m hoping to start making some initial balancing changes next week with our major update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0bf4253e88dcfc7a835944ede252e1a7e0ceeed9.png

We’ve only made 2 modifications to housing protection:
📒 It won’t start immediately
We’ve added a 5 minute grace period between pressing the “start protection” button and the protection effect going into effect. Anyone looking at the base in question will clearly know that the button has been pressed and that they’ve got 5 minutes to finish up what they’re doing and get out.

📒 Notification of Base Protection Status
Lastly, we’ll let you know in-game when the status changes in the following four ways.

First, to let you know that protection will begin soon(not right away).
Second, when protection begins.
Third, when the cooldown begins.
And fourth, when protection is available again.

Remember that if you are registered to a core, you’ll also be notified when your friend does any of the above.

We’re saving all of our other exciting changes for our major update next week. Keep your eyes peeled for news about the transition from Season 1 into Season 2.

See you soon!
-Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Offline Base Protection - Update Preview [01.19.2023]
notes.notes:
Greetings from Orbis!

How have you all been? It’s been a chilly week here in South Korea. The patches this week and next will be small since we’re getting closer to our big February update, but you’ll still like the quality of life improvements we’re adding to the game this week.

This time around we’re adding off-line base protection, as well as some improvements to in-game chat.

📒 New Base Protection Feature
Dysterra was built around the concept of raiding. Breaking down the walls to someone else’s base is thrilling, and often profitable. We’ve realized that new players, as well as casual players, struggle with being raided while they’re offline and having to start over from scratch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/152d2fd60eb5961b3824d6326a9b57e382e5fb19.png

That’s why this week we’re adding a “Base Protection” ability to your building core. Activating it will render your base invincible for a limited time depending on the complexity of your build. For example, if you have a dozen furnaces surrounded by level three walls and foundations with turrets and landmines outside, you might only have the ability to protect your base for as short as 3 hours. On the other hand, if you follow the tutorial, and have nothing but a building core inside your brand new base, it will be invincible for as long as 24 hours.

You’ll be able to tell something is protected when it is shimmering with the pattern in the video below.

[previewyoutube=eqO3oaYDloI;full][/previewyoutube]

We wanted to make sure this feature isn’t overpowered, so we’ve added some conditions that I hope will be good enough for most survivors. Let us know on Discord if it needs rebalancing.

The catch:
1. Anything powered by a repeater, or that can damage other players may be damaged while your base is protected. (i.e. Mines, turrets, electric floors, and fences can be damaged.)
2. The time remaining for the protection effect will be displayed to other players if they examine part of your build.
3. There’s a cool time of 6 hours(IRL time), regardless of how long your base is protected.
4. Your cooldown time begins if you deactivate it, and you can’t reactivate it until the 6 hours have passed.


📒 Chat Features
We’ve added two new features to chat.

The first is a list of recent private chat usernames. Communication is a key part of teamwork, and we hope this makes it easier to keep in touch with your friends… and enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ac2608a38c43e4fa85fa019cc7507b4b8c07ea56.png

We’re still polishing it, but we decided to put it in now and continue updating it as we go. You can see previous private chat partners by pressing the UP or DOWN arrow on your keyboard. Then you can use your mouse to click the person you’d like to chat with.

The second is the ability to block and unblock, other survivors. Some people are just unpleasant. So if you don’t want to hear what someone is trying to say, you can block them and never have to worry about them unless you run into them on the server.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7a35f0de1044133ce298fc527b148c5f69b40517.png

You can block someone by clicking their name in the chat window, or by opening the Survivors(L) menu, and manually blocking them by finding their username and clicking the X next to it. You may also unblock someone here if you feel like forgiving them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/af9a1b8864ff0af948499edab74dfeff33b27bdb.png


That’ll wrap up this week’s patch note. Take care!
- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Happy New Year! - Update Preview [01.11.2023]
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors
Team Dysterra here

We have updated the patch note with newest 2 new weapons included with this upcoming update on Wednesday. Please check the updated announcements!.


[hr][/hr]

Hello Survivors
Team Dysterra here 

We have encountered with unexpected problem while preparing the maintenance planned for today, Inevitably, we have to adjust the pre-announced maintenance time. We would like to ask for your understanding. We will fix this issue as soon as possible to provide the update.

Adjusted maintenance time: 11th January 2023 (Wed)

[hr][/hr]

Happy New Year, Survivors!!

I hope you’re all feeling refreshed and ready to start 2023! A good portion of our team used the end of December to get some much-needed R&R, so our patch this week is a little smaller than usual.

This week’s patch includes the end of the Christmas Skin event, some new permanent items to replace the temporary Christmas ones, two new weapons, and a few other small changes we’ve made to make Dysterra more enjoyable.

🎄Christmas is over.😥
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/05aa25baf7c63029f05fbf0e5a3c39bdf0e1c3e9.jpg
It’s the new year, and that means taking down Christmas trees and putting away the decorations until next year. I know you’ll all be sad to lose those decorations around your base, but don’t worry! The trees will still be where you put them, just without their decorations. Your storage boxes will also still have their Christmas skins, but you won’t be able to apply the Christmas skin to any new box.

📒 2 New Weapons!
We’ve also got two new weapons for you all this week! One gun, and one melee knife.

Nadelfein
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/cfbdaa292499b5b8f51b2c37ea68ac5de3421b50.jpg

The Nadelfein is a blue-tier(tier 3) bolt-action sniper rifle that uses physical ammo.
Being a bolt-action rifle, the time between shots is longer than other guns, so aim well before your enemy jumps out of range.


Cold Steel
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/977c211204e5cff0a29a1cd167515142cec435d1.jpg

Cold Steel is a blue-tier (tier 3) combat knife. It’s not quite as strong as other similar melee weapons, but its light weight allows for a faster rate of attack. It can also be thrown at an enemy if they start running away.


📒 Goodbye “Pudding”, Hello “Cleansing Shot”
The reactions to the Christmas consumables were positive, so we’ve decided to make permanent items that have the same abilities.

Starting from this patch, we’ll be introducing 2 new craftable items and 1 new item drop.

Cleansing Shot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c81beed5b5e926102d028b97b37d865233f5c472.png
The “Cleansing Shot” is a craftable item that will partially heal radiation, bleeding, and fracture status effects.

System Cooldown Pack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7666e64908918a777d99fd27b923dd51ffbd5320.png
The “System Cooldown Pack” is a craftable item that will reduce the time required to cool down from a failed hacking attempt.

Prime Bear Meat / Prime Bear Steak
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f0e0d93345e6f8d95ed47a09d6141f8926b89971.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b2dcfb9d29b398f096de0e8585c784721428e4dc.png
“Prime Bear Meat” has a chance to drop when gathering bear meat. It needs to be cooked first, but it’s very filling.

🌎 Making the world more believable
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7077856a4f3a120858b11a50f39357616b34706f.jpg
As we start to implement more stories into our game, we want the world of Dysterra to make more sense and be more believable. We’ve replaced Orbis robots with Hyena troops in specific places around the map and added a few Hyena guard posts around the map as well. For those of you that want to know more about the world of Dysterra, I’ll be sharing parts of the backstory of Ararat Island and Orbis in the (very) near future.

🔧 Other Adjustments
Some other things we fixed this time around include fixing emotes so your view doesn’t clip through your survivor’s body when you pan around while emoting.

We’ve heard player comments about the difficulty of finding a team to help tackle the harder facilities. As a result, we’ve lengthened a portion of NPC respawn times at the Chemochamber and the Meteocenter. We’ve also reduced the number of NPC spawns at the Meteocenter while at the same time reducing the total time required to “occupy” each sector. Lastly, we’ve lowered the total HP of Bombbugs at the Satellite Station.

One last thing to take into consideration is that we’ve changed the default world length to 336 days(14 days IRL), and we’ve also changed it so that worlds will last for at least 240 days (10 days IRL). This means that you can shorten or extend a server’s life, but you can only shorten it to a certain degree. We did this to give more casual players a chance to enjoy the game over the course of a week, but to also still allow players to have control over the world's lifespan.

That concludes this week’s patch note. I know it’s not as big as usual, but I hope you’ll understand that our team needed some rest after working so hard following our launch in late November. We’re all back in the office now and ready to get back to work, so I’ll see you all again next week!

-Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Emotes!!
notes.notes:
Greetings from Orbis!

I hope you’re all ready for the new year. I know the Dysterra team definitely is!!

I think you’ll like this week’s update. We’ve got a brand new emote system for you to try out, as well as 2 new weapons, 3 new attachments, and some UI changes. As always, let us know what you think on the Discord server!

📒 Emote Yourself!
Communication with other players is part of what makes a game fun. Typing in the chat window can be a pain during intense situations, and there’s always a chance that your teammates won’t see it.

[previewyoutube=DKuqSQ2elMw;full][/previewyoutube]

With emotes you can communicate more easily with other survivors by holding the F4 button, hovering over the action you want to perform, and then releasing the F4 button. We’ve programmed it so you’re unable to use an emote while you’re jumping, gliding, swimming, crouching, or aiming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a797bbb9826f1adc6245cedf2f97dcb9f4e1094f.jpg

Currently you can choose one of eight expressions:
- Hello
- You’re done
- Bang
- Clap
- Surrender
- Shhh
- Go
- Hate (No thanks)

📒 2 New Weapons
SUBMACHINE GUN MMP-500X ECLAIR
This tier-3 (Blue Tier) gun inflicts the bleeding status effect in addition to regular damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c16480640138d8c58be683b930699f551f10e858.png

TOMAHAWK
This throwable weapon can also be used to hack your enemies into pieces. It’s slightly weaker than the BF Machete, but the fact that it gives enemies the “bleeding” status effect more than makes up the difference.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1075f0c61712a30b05ae1430335a856cd3e79703.png

📒 Other Improvements To Weapons
- 3 new gun attachments: an advanced silencer, an advanced compensator, and an advanced vertical grip
- Louder guns are more likely to catch the attention of NPCs.
- Melee weapons are more powerful across the board.
- The BF Machete, as well as both types of cyclops claws, now give the “bleeding” status effect.

📒 Terrafire Countdown UI Improvement
We heard some survivors complaining about the terrafire countdown being annoying and covering the main part of the screen for far too long. We’ve changed it so that now the countdown is more discrete until there’s only 1 day left (1 hour of real world time).

More than 1 day left (1 hour IRL)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a4c9c8b95140090fd0bcefdc0493e0946cf34160.png
Less than 1 day left (1 hour IRL)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/58244a3467fa5bacece1f9700463cf4bcd2ed9c2.png

📒 “Skip All” Button
We know there are quite a few pop-ups when you load into the game for the first time each day. For people that are in a hurry, and want to get into the servers as fast as possible, we’ve added an “X” in the upper right corner that you can click to skip all of the achievement and point notifications.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/acf01ec7378aa55f1ce6423cf6ba01d301d98643.png

That’s it for this week’s patch. I’ll see you all next year with more great updates to Dysterra.

Stay warm!
- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] New Type of Cyclops, Sliding doors, and more!
notes.notes:
Happy holidays from Orbis!

For all of you survivors cooped inside while it’s snowing outside, I’ve got another great update for you. This time around, we’ve got new cyclops wandering around the main part of the map, a completed set of hazmat equipment, improvements to turrets, new sliding doorwalls, and some balance changes that most of you will like.

Before we get into the nitty gritty, I’d like to quickly cover what no-raid servers are.

📒 No Raid Servers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5396c0bbda0c85dc3be8a2761a349aafcf062707.jpg
As many of you have probably already noticed, we’ve added a “No Raid” test server to our game’s server list. It’s exactly the same as a PvP server, except that you can’t damage peoples’ bases. Many players have expressed their frustration over losing all of their progress when they return to the game only to learn that their base has been raided, and they’ve lost everything.

We’re testing out the concept, so if you feel that you’re a more casual player, then jump into one of our No Raid test servers and try it out. If more people enjoy them, we plan on expanding them to more regions.

📒 Field Cyclops
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d8112503af555cd7f37cd293106a6bc932c16e58.png
The space between hyena and orbis bases has been rather void of danger. But we want Ararat Island to feel like a dangerous place… So keep your eyes open for some cyclops wandering around in the Danger Level 3 portion of the map.

📒 New Hazmat Equipment
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/54960207ad1364e32dc17865cb56d6a3684c7571.jpg
For those of you that really don’t like walking through radiation, we’ve completed the hazmat set for you. You’ll get great protection from the radiation, but that’s it. Be careful and pack some extra medical shots before you go on your next farming trip.


📒 Turret Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0bd356621ae8e0d6b3a6df13ba00f4f056aa61a5.jpg
Players haven’t been using turrets as much as we’d like to see. The main complaints were that they were easy to destroy, and had poor aim.

We’ve rebalanced all of our turrets’ damage and HP to hopefully take a step towards making turrets a more pivotal part of base defense. Be sure to test out your neighbor’s turrets after we update the servers!

📒 Sliding Doors/walls

[previewyoutube=D0GP39Y5FLg;full][/previewyoutube]
So far there’s only been two kinds of doors for your base: a normal door, and a garage door. In this patch, we’re adding a sliding door to the game. You can craft it, and place it like you would any wall. They’re a structural support, so you can build floors/ceilings on top of them.

⚖️ Game Balance Changes
🔧 Furnaces
A few players have been using furnace farms to game the rankings system. We also want players to spend their time in-game exploring the world, and interacting with NPCs… not waiting in their base for their furnaces to refine materials.

To balance gameplay, we’ve increased the energy upkeep cost of furnaces to reduce the existence of furnace farms. Please remember that you can adjust your furnace’s processing speed to reduce the amount of energy it consumes.

🔧 Grenades and Landmines
These were originally intended to be used against NPCs and players, and not for infiltrating bases. We’ve made grenades give varying damage depending on the enemy’s proximity to the explosion. We’ve also increased the max damage for grenades, while also making it so that all landmines give 0 (zero) damage to buildings.

🔧 Energy DMR & DMR SW-1
We’ve noticed that few people are using the energy DMR or the DMR SW-1, so we’ve increased their DPS. At the same time, we increased the size of the energy DMR’s magazine to include more shots between reloads.

🔧 Assault Rifle DVG14 & Energy Assault Rifle EC MK-III
We’ve also noticed that the Tier 4(purple) assault rifles only had a minor advantage over Tier 3(blue) guns, so we’ve improved their DPS as well as increased their magazine size.


That’s it for this week’s patch. Have a good one!
- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Holiday Chests, Radiation Balancing, and more
notes.notes:
Holiday greetings from Orbis!

We’ve got some more Christmas themed skins for you this week, as well as quite a few quality of life improvements. Keep on reading to learn more about how to use the Christmas chest skins, sorting options for the chest viewer, balancing changes to radiation (you’ll like these!), and bigger stack sizes to medical shots.

📒 More Christmas Cheer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7d4a3c744ab51e50e3c02a21e2d613e62a9c9dc0.png
In addition to Christmas trees and holiday snacks, you now have the option to store your hard earned items in a holiday-themed chest. You can apply the christmas skin when crafting your chests, or you can right-click a chest when it’s in your inventory and use the “equip skins” option.

📒 Nearby Chest Viewer - Sorting
Our nearby chest viewer has really helped alleviate the stress of rummaging through chest after chest to find(or not find!) what you’re looking for. We’re updating the viewer to allow users to sort their chests in alphabetical order(and reverse alphabetical order), as well as in order of chest tier (ascending or descending).

Don’t forget that you can click and drag items between chests!

📒 Radiation Balancing
Constantly having to use anti-radiation shots breaks up the flow of the game, so we’re hoping this patch will make areas with radiation a bit more enjoyable.

We’ve lowered the amount of radiation exposure in many areas to reflect their difficulty. (For those that weren’t aware, different areas have different strengths of radiation.)

At the same time, we’ve added “radiation resistance.”
Before, your radiation level would go to zero after using an anti-radiation shot, and then immediately start going up again. Now, radiation resistance is basically a negative radiation value that allows you to not take any radiation damage for a short while.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7f4fda4801faaae11269d5215c356421522390a4.jpg
If your radiation level is 25, and you use a level 1 anti-radiation shot(-100), you’ll have a “radiation resistance” value of 75.
Once it reaches zero, you’ll start taking damage again, so be careful.

📒 Larger Stack Sizes for Medical Shots
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b6a44d62c67b4164a8a83d71ad2ce4e75566015a.jpg
Level 3 medical shots are so powerful that we originally thought it best to keep their max stack size low. But that ended up just making players use lower level medical shots that allowed larger stack sizes.

We’ve doubled the stack sizes for level 2 medical shots(from 10 to 20), and more than tripled the stacks for level 3 shots(from 3 to 10).

📒 A change to building rules
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c1e2a53983256a56a35847ce5a6cf377b404b369.png
From this patch, anything you build that is not inside your building core’s range will be accessible by anyone after 10 minutes. So remember to place a building core nearby if you don’t want other players demolishing whatever it is you’re making.


For all of you who’ve been asking for a roadmap, I’ll be posting it soon.

See you on the servers!
- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Hardcore Mode, A.I. Improvements, and more
notes.notes:
Greetings from Orbis!

I hope you all have been enjoying the changes we made in our last patch! Many of the major bugs have been ironed out over the past two weeks, and now we’re focused on optimizing gameplay systems and improving overall player experience. We’re still watching the channels in our Discord Server, so you’re welcome to leave feedback whenever you feel like sharing.

This week we have updates to enemy AI, facility skills, ranking points, balancing, and we’re finally opening the hardcore servers you’ve all been asking for.

🔗Link to Dec 7th Update Details🔗

AI Improvements for NPCs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2ea95c4ac7a0249dbd56c4c7b860230a2d84f74a.jpg
We’re working hard on the AI in Dysterra, and we’ll be making incremental updates as we go. This week we made the AI more realistic by updating how mobs detect their surroundings. They’re more sensitive to nearby sounds, so they’re now more likely to hear someone walking nearby, or react to gunshots from a greater distance.

They’re also a lot more persistent. So now they shouldn't randomly turn around and return to their original spot. They’ll keep running after you as long as they can see you.

We’re hoping these changes will increase the overall tension in the game.

Facility Skills : World Span Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/abf84f7f501d9fe523d2a5f32ae1a848f42b3247.png
Unlike other games that wipe their servers every x days, Dysterra let’s survivors control when (or if) a wipe happens. By using the controllers you get when conquering a facility, you’ll be able to lengthen or shorten the lifespan of your server. 

We looked at the difficulty of each facility, and adjusted the values according to how many people conquered each facility, and how much each controller was used to increase or decrease the number of days left till wipe. You can press ‘K’ during gameplay to access the facility menu and learn more.

Please note: each server has a maximum lifespan, and the server life cannot be increased past that value.

We are also aware that survivors are interested in a variety of server lifespans, and we’re planning to comment on that at a later date.

Ranking point changes when escaping the world
[previewyoutube=LRnvzuE7LCA;full][/previewyoutube]
When a server is ready to wipe (see facility skills section above), players can get on a rocket to escape and earn extra points to improve their global ranking.

Originally you would only receive a set amount of points for getting on the rocket, but now you’ll get a different amount depending on how long you survived in the world. The longer you survived, the more points you’ll get!

New Hardcore Servers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0585a0bdf97bf8c7409632d7df24d22acadf9600.jpg
The hardcore servers you’ve all been waiting for are finally coming!! PvP in Dysterra has never been this thrilling! Be prepared to drop EVERYTHING when you die.

Hardcore servers aren’t for the faint of heart: 
- No safety slots! You drop all of your items when you die.
- You start with only the bare essential items.

Everything else is exactly the same.

Balance Changes
On a side note, we added the “fracture” status effect to a number of enemies. “Fracture” reduces your speed temporarily.

We also increased the attack power for a number of enemies. I think it’ll be more fun if I don’t tell you which ones.

I look forward to seeing you all on the servers!
- Director K

notes.title: [Dev Note] First balance patch (Energy consumption, Radiation and more)
notes.notes:
Greetings from Orbis!

We’ve been listening.

I’d like to say thank you to all of the amazing survivors that have taken time out of their days to give feedback and help us improve Dysterra. We sincerely appreciate your efforts and are doing our best to fix any issues as quickly as we can.

We’ve also been implementing anti-cheat solutions on an almost daily basis to prevent hackers from ruining everyone’s fun.

Here’s what we’re adding/changing/removing in this patch:

1. Energy Consumption
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/97ed9e03431f0f208d8024d88b9319c786a11296.png
Improvements to energy consumption in bases.
- Increased maximum power reserves of all levels of building core.
- Increased the amount of energy received when converting terrasite in the building core.

2. Offline Base Protection
- Increased the maximum purchasable amount for base defense items in terrasite transmitter stores.
- Adjusted prices for base defense items in terrasite transmitter stores.

3. Radiation
Improvements to radiation management.
- Reduced the cost of anti-radiation level 2 shots.
- Increased how much anti-radiation level 2 shots reduce radiation levels
- Increased radiation resistance of the hazmat shirt armor.
- We are planning more radiation related buffs in the near future. 

4. Respawning
- Drastically reduced respawn cooldown time for all types of beds.

5. Fine Terrasite Farming
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2d63baebfdabf7ccf8008f05ae29483f3fd06cd6.jpg
- Improved the probability of collecting fine terrasite when mining from fine terrasite nodes and 
superior terrasite nodes.

6. Garage Doors
A large number of survivors commented about how their vehicles were being stolen.
- We added a cheaper, more accessible garage door for bases.
- The existing garage door is now the level 2 upgrade of the new cheaper garage door.

7. Hacking Probabilities
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4f8cb20f94c88430bb191750427ae3aa08028002.png
- Due to a multitude of complaints of vehicle theft on the island, we’ve severely lowered the success rate of vehicle hacking.
- We’ve also raised the success probability for some secure crates (hackable crates).

8. Recipe Error
Fixed the “fine fiber boots” recipe.
- The recipe for crafting fine fiber boots was different when crafting with a workbench vs. without a workbench. We’ve lowered the cost of the workbench recipe so that both recipes are the same.

9. Daily Missions
- We removed missions related to building due to their impracticality.

10. Building
- We made the process of installing/placing Floors(ceilings) a bit more easy and intuitive.

A note to survivors regarding non-repairable items:
Some survivors have asked about why some items are not repairable. These items in the game can be obtained quickly through spot events. To discourage abuse of these drops, these items are non-repairable. Please keep this in mind while playing the game.


We’re sure you’ll like these changes. But feel free to let us know your opinions on the Discord servers!

Stay alive out there,
- Director K

notes.title: 2nd beta test update guide part 4 - changed latter part of the game
notes.notes:
Changed landmarks that can be dominated by co-oping with other players and newly added Terrasite exchanger and escape route. 

1. Chemochamber
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0c3be8fe300df0b3159f8a46270c393d993a4184.jpg

Chemochamber that is located on the coordinate “X2587 Y1131”, is a place where they study about effects of Terrasite on living organisms. They especially focus on testing genetic mutations and diseases through animal experiments. 

At the Chemochamber, you can get resources like the Energy core and Super Telephoto Lens, which you can craft 5 tier weapons with. You can also obtain a phase controller that can activate the phase control effect. 
※  Please refer to in-game radiogram (Short key ‘J’) > Item list 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b6d3de8504ffe056fcfc86a84c259574fb7ad7df.png

[Chemical Phase controller effect] 
- Air purification: skill activated area will heal survivors constantly until the effect ends. 
※ Terrafire eruption + 6
[previewyoutube=EsWHh9u0sLM;full][/previewyoutube]

- Dust storm: In the skill activated area, survivors will be exposed to radiation which will take their HP.  
※ Terrafire eruption -12
[previewyoutube=ouvumOVDNiM;full][/previewyoutube]

[Tips on clearing Chemochamber]
Activate 2 key card consoles and open the main center gate. 
(2 key cards can be obtained by taking out Talone Brute near consoles).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0e99bc88e2e9afa117fb1aa42a7e1d44b583da07.jpg

- Destroy the energy pylon on the first floor, you will then have access to the second floor entrance. 
(Energy pylons can only be destroyed after taking out all mutant guardians connected to the energy pylons) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2cd7a9b92ce77ff50be5f8a23d63a49380dec4f0.jpg

- When the chamber core on the second floor is destroyed, a phase controller can be obtained. 
(Chamber core can only be destroyed after taking out mutant guardians connected to it) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/aae2686d9026a69a811b0ae08f7a82a091327fb1.jpg

2. Geolab
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6095de619145fdf3ae5a90f6f9a3417fc3c6d783.jpg

Geolab that is located on the coordinate ‘X1557 Y 1460’ is a laboratory that is created to increase the Terrasite output. Its’ main focus is to promote crystallization of Terrasites scattered underground due to seismic waves. 

At the Geolab, you can obtain Energy core and Super Telephoto Lens, and you can earn a Geodynamic phase controller from here. 
※  Please refer to in-game radiogram (Short key ‘J’) > Item list 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4cef319cf813dd7f3a14695d94b218b80dbc7c89.png

[Geodynamic phase controller effect] 
- Ground stabilization: It decreases the degradation effect on the buildings in the selected area. 
※ Terrafire eruption +8
[previewyoutube=2BDS5RCFF48;full][/previewyoutube]

- Seismic wave: Gives building damage in the selected area
※ Terrafire eruption -16
[previewyoutube=qHTGbKFUR98;full][/previewyoutube]

[Geolab clear guide] 
The central gate can be opened by activating 4 escape gates. 
(Activated escape gates will deactivate after certain period of time)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ef8b41708786110f5ac3cf57d798f9d59f934450.jpg

After entering the central gate, take out the NPCs and obtain a phase controller. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6b1f81ef5e2cf94aeb504e2d28215e2f21d532f0.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0d6f42efeaa36d95b1bb43b569e0eee3853a2c2c.jpg

3. Field boss 
From the three marked areas in the image down below, huge amount of Terrasite can be obtained, but it is inevitable to encounter field boss Juggernaut in those areas. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/62357419ddab896fc57c693dddea1e385ed3f3f4.png

After taking out the Juggernaut, “Juggernaut core” can be obtained, which will give you a variety of items needed for winning battles. Not only that huge amount of Terrasite can be earned as well. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/abd98195c084428f231b0273639d8c84aeab9d96.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8c5444f4c4462a44c9c6bc32671c777c771491e5.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/460cfd9bd2988d89e278cef27951655ca1b59884.jpg

4. Terrasite exchanger transmitter
With the newly added ‘Terrasite exchange transmitter’ you can exchange looted Terrasite with “Terrasite points” 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9a17387f766f6275b936f99cf577f9541f80337b.jpg

With the Terrasite points, you can earn variety of items needed for you survival in Dysterra. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a70f57f198124d99f328c481d508a2c7b007b540.jpg

Exchanged item is given through mailbox (Short key ‘P). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0eef9a83f53eff8e74548845256d02b2e3f62bbc.jpg

5. Escape system

When the countdown begins for the Terrafire eruption. There will be Escape Rockets in 3 different places. With the escape rocket boarding code, you can get on the rocket and go back to Orbis safely. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/73849b2872bcc136de05a928dec122bad3cf911f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/54cf177d32cbe331352c311e432e2dff5f2efbce.png

In order to board those rockets, you have to upgrade your machine arm (Short key ‘Y’). 


Rocket boarding code can be obtained with Terrasite points in the Terrasite exchange transmitter. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/52c290fdedc11889bb949cbda855edda920cd42f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/61f61680835d918046f968f18e6f7b31e0335e17.jpg

Utilizing the Teleport device on the 1st floor of Launch Bases will bring you to the rooftop where the Escape Rocket is located.
  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a20b6bfd9b18002299777ce37eddb81bcff92936.jpg

I wish everyone a safe escape before the Terrafire erupts! : ) 
[previewyoutube=5iF3gw7fU2Q;full][/previewyoutube]

6. CUSTOM SERVER SYSTEM
You can enjoy the game with your friends by creating your own custom server apart from the Official servers.
You can modify the main world settings and create various environments on custom servers.
*Some of the settings required through out the guide may affect your PC security and functions.

- CUSTOM SERVER SYSTEM guide [LINK]

Thanks.

Thumper

You can craft Thumper on the Plasma workbench with required resources: Accelerator (craft), High resistor (loot), Energy core (loot), Terrasite Concentrate (craft/create).

Rokita

- Type: Rocket Launcher
- Ammo: Rocket Catridge
- Damage Type: Explosion
- Damage: 220

Rokita, with its tremendous building damage, can effectively be used to destroy bases. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b0baa5e5186b9e3cf9f0732b6555b66d1246688a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ebc339da1bc1ea7b7e6464e40cdd49c171bf3145.png

notes.title: 2nd beta test update guide part 2 - Vehicle and new traps
notes.notes:
We would like to introduce a new way to use vehicles and traps you will face on our 2nd beta test.

[Changed way to use a vehicle]
Over the world, there will randomly be “DYNAMO with no tires” along the road, unlike the previous world, survivors cannot drive it immediately. Restoration system has been added to drive DYNAMO only with crafted vehicle tires.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5be62f50668d5f746b535d5f1e7124cf7956cca9.jpg

After equipping “Vehicle Tires”, restored vehicles can be refuelled through maintenance menu(F HOLD) and you can also restore decreased durability from the damage done by other survivors. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a48074491eb8de132dfce28444caf7055b1bad01.jpg



Can make DYNAMO with no tires re-drivable again.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6d8e46935023f6274fd9ae090ce11263b33d6491.png


It is a consumable Battery that is used for refuelling vehicles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/16398392ffdcf1bffa96470d21238a6652f05460.png


Vehicles can be fixed using bolt, Sensor, Wire in proportion to decreased durability.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c1e497af7ff5518f1db34ef17a7441d9bedac250.png

When durability has been completely damaged, DYNAMO turns to “Broken vehicle”, and cannot be driven anymore.
Few resources are obtainable through unusable “Broken vehicle”
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5a435b21ca10013ce462ce3c297ac0744284e5b8.jpg

[Guide for new traps]

1. Two new turrets 
two new turrets are added each using different types of ammo.


Automated defense turret using light ammo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/220c3fa6883f7bd52b5bd8275a4fb73a1e20c615.png


Automated defense turret using shotgun slug.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5fe96350ca9b253d6de4f5c4677e506ee7e93d74.png


Automated defense turret using energy ammo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/393cc20aa46a62c297e009e3233498ed26c040bc.png

Turrets can be installed with different types of ammo. Therefore, turrets are able to react differently to other types of ammo/armor being used by intruders. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/84a50affde915814337a84a29de7a8f9b3c1c2f7.jpg

2. Two new base traps are added
Originally, there were only traps that are shaped in squares. Now,  
two types of triangle base traps have been added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/58913a1482150dd009aeae9f3bdd7b217c9c2f09.jpg


It is a transparent floor that can be installed up on the ceiling. Please note that it cannot be installed on the ground or foundation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b8ef8abff047031521e2208e21c7345f3eeeaa70.png


Electric Floor can be installed right on the ground or foundation.
Depending on its electricity consumption settings, damages vary along with it. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0a76fad3bf856946837e044be00ce2b1866dca74.png

You can trick and get rid of intruders with a combination of these two different types of trap
[previewyoutube=p3FpmnETQfs;full][/previewyoutube]

3. Installments for base management
These updated installments will help survivors to manage their basecamp better. 


Garage doors can be installed at the edge of ceiling enabling vehicles to go in and out.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8c5ac983bb07fa82e692c6dd0e11bd4e4967a411.png
[previewyoutube=UpgmDNBRx18;full][/previewyoutube]

Survivors can not only use this garage door for DYNAMO, but it can also be used for different purposes as well. For example, you can put your storages inside these garage doors. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1d706b93d1d31264a8b169d89b992dd8bfcb2776.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d6fde15af7bfe686c7a2c8f511134d998a0d4463.jpg


It is a device managing the installed machines all at once.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f7521f4dccfa413eadc93e05ff2a4e94b4f7a3e9.png
[previewyoutube=fXFv78crcCw;full][/previewyoutube]

Crafting, fixing, and power management of all the installed machines inside your base can now be controlled by this device all at once.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/18f348438ce8ed28468858e6de74b89d4456fa5d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ced6c207c2379a56fceb75846daa425c92300629.jpg


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a352d76b5517843e775582267b17e2b64dc51c59.png
The machine that survivors will find the most important. Method of using this ‘Terrasite Exchange Transmitter’ will be explained through another post before the test begins. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3a9215dd62631e700a11deacc485e476774c07b5.jpg

Please wishlist and follow Dysterra for more updates and information. 
We will come back with better and improved Dysterra next week! 

Thanks survivors

notes.title: Crafting, Housing update, and Frontier test
notes.notes:
Here’s our updates on crafting and housing

[Crafting update]

Few changes mentioned below will be updated for better surviving and battle during the early part of the game.

1. Gun craft difficulty adjusted and pistol ammo added.

Difficulty adjustment on overall looting, survivors can now craft 1st and 2nd tier weapons in a shorter period of time.
Moreover, survivors can craft 3rd tier weapons on the field without a workbench that can only be installed in basecamp. However, please note that there will be disadvantages on durability and resource consumption on 2nd and 3rd tier weapons crafted on the field.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b108405677f119b6fa4743fc09f57b7745bdd93e.jpg

Also, pistol ammo can be crafted with low cost which can lead to usage of Agons without any pressure of using many resources. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/32231689f87473701a495158dbe3a5727a1dbf6b.png

2.   New item: sleeping bag

When a character dies, the sleeping bag works as a respawning point. Unlike bed, it can easily be installed without building a basecamp.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/84b8413fbbb5bae229e637d0b0f29e4f9677d622.jpg

However, it does have a longer cooldown duration compared to the bed. When respawned, cooldown duration will be activated on the sleeping bag itself and any bed located nearby. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ea5a984413c8483f5904d8a3df8ffe0cdfe4fc68.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3f2d89e9f0f160df64219b242f901dd400ddd30f.png

[Housing update]

For more convenient basecamp management, crafting mode and production settings are partially changed.

1. Housing parts diversification

Crafting mode(F2) Housing ring UI will be categorised by same or similar housing parts 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/447e53dd12d12f1b84fd492a3951258e349dcd8a.jpg

Also with our new pillar parts on housing, survivors can build various types of basecamp with special exterior.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5acfc1007f606ddfdfc2e25a2d76cfc79245f8d4.jpg

2. Workbench integration

To simplify production and management settings, Plasma workbench now takes care of both weapons and armors. With this change, survivors can now manage their bases with more efficiency.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6b98e0171c8f960ab037a4c37ef14712896a06f0.jpg

[Frontier test]

Our update mentioned above, and many other unrevealed updates will be opened to survivors through our frontier test that will take place next week.

More detailed schedules and guides will be shared through our Discord and Steam community starting from next week.

Thanks,
